title: Repairing Broken Access Control in Web Applications with LLMs: An Empirical Benchmark Study
title_zh: 用LLM修复Web应用中的访问控制失效：一项实证基准研究

paragraphs.en: Broken access control (BAC) ranks among the most severe web-application vulnerability classes, yet its automated repair remains largely unexplored. Unlike memory-safety vulnerabilities, BAC is a logic vulnerability whose repair demands a deep understanding of an application’s access-control model and business semantics, which traditional automated vulnerability repair techniques handle poorly. Large language models (LLMs) open a promising avenue for this problem, but no standard benchmark exists for studying how well they repair BAC vulnerabilities. We construct BAC-Bench , the first benchmark for BAC repair, consisting of 46 real-world BAC vulnerabilities drawn from six widely used web applications spanning four programming languages. Each vulnerability is equipped with a sandboxed runtime environment, a PoC validation program and a functional test program. We further propose a BAC repair-strategy framework that characterizes any BAC patch along four dimensions, Position, Coverage, Mechanism, and Content. Evaluating eight base LLMs and two commercial LLM agents on BAC-Bench , we find that single-turn base LLMs repair 37.68% of the vulnerabilities on average, while two minimal scaffolds, Apply-Feedback and Navigate-and-Locate , raise this average to 66.03%, with the best base LLM reaching 75.36%, close to the 78.99% of the best agent. Notably, some LLM-generated patches surpass the official patches, and one incidentally closed a zero-day vulnerability that had lain dormant for three years. Our findings delineate the current capability boundary of LLM-based BAC repair and offer guidance toward its practical adoption.
paragraphs.zh: 越权访问控制（BAC）是最严重的Web应用漏洞类别之一，然而其自动化修复在很大程度上仍未被探索。 与内存安全漏洞不同，BAC是一种逻辑漏洞，其修复需要深入理解应用的访问控制模型和业务语义，而传统的自动化漏洞修复技术对此处理得并不好。 大语言模型（LLM）为这一问题开辟了一条有前景的途径，但目前尚无标准基准来研究它们修复BAC漏洞的能力。 我们构建了BAC-Bench，这是首个用于BAC修复的基准，包含来自六个广泛使用的Web应用、涵盖四种编程语言的46个真实世界BAC漏洞。 每个漏洞都配备了沙箱化的运行环境、PoC验证程序和功能测试程序。 我们进一步提出了一个BAC修复策略框架，从位置（Position）、覆盖面（Coverage）、机制（Mechanism）和内容（Content）四个维度刻画任意BAC补丁。 在BAC-Bench上评估八个基础LLM和两个商业LLM智能体，我们发现单轮基础LLM平均修复37.68%的漏洞，而两个最小化的脚手架Apply-Feedback和Navigate-and-Locate将这一平均值提升至66.03%，其中表现最好的基础LLM达到75.36%，接近最佳智能体的78.99%。 值得注意的是，一些LLM生成的补丁超越了官方补丁，其中一个还顺带修复了一个潜伏三年之久的零日漏洞。 我们的研究发现划定了基于LLM的BAC修复当前的能力边界，并为其走向实际应用提供了指导。

paragraphs.en: Broken access control (BAC) has become one of the most damaging classes of software vulnerabilities. Reports from Mondoo and MITRE document the prevalence of BAC, with CWE-862 Missing Authorization increasing by 56% from 2024 to 2025 and rising from rank 9 to rank 4 in MITRE’s 2025 CWE Top 25, while CWE-284 Improper Access Control increased by 73% ( Mondoo, 2026 ; MITRE, 2025 ) . OWASP likewise ranks BAC the first web-application risk ( OWASP Foundation, 2021 ; OWASP Foundation, 2025 ) and the first API risk ( OWASP Foundation, 2023a ) . Its consequences are equally severe. In December 2024, the Irish Data Protection Commission fined Meta €251 million for an access-control design defect whose leaked access token exposed the profiles of 29 million users ( Data Protection Commission (2024), Ireland ) . Meanwhile, the sheer scale of disclosure is overwhelming manual remediation, and AI is accelerating the trend. A record 48,185 CVEs were published in 2025 ( Gamblin, 2026 ) , and disclosures in the first four months of 2026 already ran 46% above projections, prompting FIRST to raise its full-year forecast to approximately 66,000 and putting annual disclosures on pace to approach 70,000 for the first time in history ( Forum of Incident Response and Security Teams (2026), FIRST ) . In May 2026, Anthropic reported that Project Glasswing had used a frontier model to uncover more than 10,000 high- or critical-severity vulnerabilities in widely deployed software within its first month, yet only 75 of the 530 such vulnerabilities disclosed to maintainers had been patched ( Anthropic, 2026 ) . This combination of surging prevalence, severe impact, and lagging repair makes the automated repair of BAC vulnerabilities an urgent priority.
paragraphs.zh: 失效的访问控制（BAC）已成为危害最大的一类软件漏洞。 Mondoo 和 MITRE 的报告记录了 BAC 的普遍性：CWE-862 缺失授权从 2024 年到 2025 年增加了 56%，并在 MITRE 2025 年 CWE Top 25 中从第 9 位升至第 4 位，而 CWE-284 不当访问控制增加了 73%（Mondoo, 2026；MITRE, 2025）。 OWASP 同样将 BAC 列为第一大 Web 应用风险（OWASP Foundation, 2021；OWASP Foundation, 2025）和第一大 API 风险（OWASP Foundation, 2023a）。 其后果同样严重。 2024 年 12 月，爱尔兰数据保护委员会因一处访问控制设计缺陷对 Meta 处以 2.51 亿欧元罚款，该缺陷导致的访问令牌泄露暴露了 2900 万用户的个人资料（Data Protection Commission (2024), Ireland）。 与此同时，漏洞披露的庞大规模正在使人工修复不堪重负，而 AI 正在加速这一趋势。 2025 年发布的 CVE 数量创下 48,185 项的纪录（Gamblin, 2026），且 2026 年前四个月的披露数量已比预期高出 46%，促使 FIRST 将全年预测上调至约 66,000 项，使年度披露数量有望首次接近 70,000 项（Forum of Incident Response and Security Teams (2026), FIRST）。 2026 年 5 月，Anthropic 报告称，Project Glasswing 在首个阶段内利用前沿模型在广泛部署的软件中发现了超过 10,000 个高危或严重级别的漏洞，但向维护者披露的 530 个此类漏洞中仅有 75 个已被修复（Anthropic, 2026）。 激增的普遍性、严重的影响与滞后的修复共同使得 BAC 漏洞的自动化修复成为一项紧迫的优先任务。

paragraphs.en: The detection of the BAC has been studied extensively ( Dalton et al., 2009 ; Sun et al., 2011 ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . White-box approaches infer the intended access-control specification from the program itself and flag missing or inconsistent checks, with the detection granularity sharpened from the function level to the object level ( Sun et al., 2011 ; Monshizadeh et al., 2014 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . Black-box approaches drop the source-code requirement and instead decide violations from externally observable behavior ( Zuo et al., 2017 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . Work that directly targets BAC repair, by contrast, remains scarce. FixMeUp, one of the earliest such efforts, mines an access-control template from PHP applications and inserts it where a check is missing, but it relies on developers to hand-annotate sensitive operations and their checks ( Son et al., 2013 ) . LogicPatcher uses path profiling to place patches for already-detected vulnerabilities ( Monshizadeh et al., 2016 ) . DRacv extends this paradigm to both PHP and Java, deriving patches from contrasts between vulnerable and protected pages and deploying each as a standalone guard file ahead of the vulnerable page ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Yet all of them handle only missing checks, rely on fixed templates or execution-flow patterns, and are designed for traditional architectures, limiting their applicability to the modern web applications in wide use today.
paragraphs.zh: 针对BAC的检测已得到广泛研究（Dalton et al., 2009；Sun et al., 2011；Lu et al., 2022；Shi et al., 2025）。 白盒方法从程序本身推断预期的访问控制规范，并标记缺失或不一致的检查，其检测粒度也从函数级细化到对象级（Sun et al., 2011；Monshizadeh et al., 2014；Huang et al., 2024）。 黑盒方法则摒弃了对源代码的要求，转而根据外部可观察的行为来判定违规（Zuo et al., 2017；Liu et al., 2025）。 相比之下，直接针对BAC修复的工作仍然稀缺。 FixMeUp是最早的此类尝试之一，它从PHP应用中挖掘访问控制模板，并将其插入到缺失检查的位置，但它依赖于开发人员手工标注敏感操作及其检查（Son et al., 2013）。 LogicPatcher使用路径剖析来为已检测到的漏洞放置补丁（Monshizadeh et al., 2016）。 DRacv将这一范式扩展到PHP和Java，通过对比易受攻击页面与受保护页面来生成补丁，并将每个补丁部署为位于易受攻击页面之前的独立守护文件（Xu et al., 2025）。 然而它们都只能处理缺失的检查，依赖固定模板或执行流模式，并且是为传统架构设计的，这限制了它们对当今广泛使用的现代Web应用的适用性。

paragraphs.en: In summary, BAC repairing receive little attention from researchers because of three main reasons. (1) BAC is a logic vulnerability that lacks modelable syntactic and data-flow signatures. Unlike memory-safety vulnerabilities (e.g., buffer overflow, use-after-free) and injection vulnerabilities (e.g., SQL injection, XSS) that exhibit fixed syntactic patterns or explicit source-to-sink flows, BAC are deeply entangled with business logic and amount to the absence or malfunction of authorization logic, which has neither a fixed syntactic form nor a traceable flow, so pattern-based repair methods do not transfer. (2) Unlike detection, repairing task requires an explicit correctness specification to target. Detection need only judge whether an access violates the intended policy, which can be inferred from inconsistencies. Repairing task, by contrast, need to determine the intended access-control policy, which in practice is usually undocumented or scattered through the business logic, and then realize it faithfully within the concrete context of the application’s source code. Any slight semantic ambiguity or implementation slip, can introduce new logic errors or over-restrict legitimate access. (3) Web access-control implementations are heterogeneous, lacking the standardized mechanisms of smart contracts. In smart contracts, access control centers on a few standardized mechanisms (e.g., msg.sender , the onlyOwner modifier), a regularity that recent smart-contract repair leverages by mining common RBAC practices to guide patch generation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Web applications honor no such convention. Different applications adopt RBAC, ABAC, or DAC and realize their checks in disparate forms (session variables, database permission tables, or custom validators), with the logic often spread across many files and call layers, so a repair tool cannot rely on a uniform template or prior knowledge to patch accurately across applications.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，BAC 修复很少受到研究者关注，原因主要有三点。 (1) BAC 是一种逻辑漏洞，缺乏可建模的语法特征和数据流特征。 与内存安全漏洞（如缓冲区溢出、释放后使用）和注入漏洞（如 SQL 注入、XSS）不同，后者表现出固定的语法模式或显式的从源到汇的数据流，而 BAC 与业务逻辑深度纠缠，本质上等同于授权逻辑的缺失或失灵，既没有固定的语法形式也没有可追踪的数据流，因此基于模式的修复方法无法迁移。 (2) 与检测不同，修复任务需要一个明确的正确性规范作为目标。 检测只需判断某次访问是否违反了预期策略，而这类违反可以从不一致性中推断出来。 相比之下，修复任务需要确定预期的访问控制策略——该策略在实践中通常没有文档记录，或散布在业务逻辑中——然后在应用程序源代码的具体上下文中忠实地实现它。 任何细微的语义歧义或实现失误，都可能引入新的逻辑错误或过度限制合法访问。 (3) Web 访问控制的实现是异构的，缺乏智能体合约那样的标准化机制。 在智能体合约中，访问控制围绕少数几种标准化机制展开（如 msg.sender、onlyOwner 修饰符），近期智能体合约修复工作正是利用这种规律性，通过挖掘常见的 RBAC 实践来指导补丁生成（Zhang et al., 2025）。 Web 应用程序没有遵循这样的惯例。 不同应用程序采用 RBAC、ABAC 或 DAC，并以不同形式（会话变量、数据库权限表或自定义校验器）实现其检查，逻辑往往分散在多个文件和调用层中，因此修复工具无法依赖统一的模板或先验知识来跨应用程序进行准确的修补。

sents.en: Detection need only judge whether an access violates the intended policy, which can be inferred from inconsistencies.
sents.zh: 检测只需判断某次访问是否违反了预期策略，而这类违反可以从不一致性中推断出来。

sents.en: Repairing task, by contrast, need to determine the intended access-control policy, which in practice is usually undocumented or scattered through the business logic, and then realize it faithfully within the concrete context of the application’s source code.
sents.zh: 相比之下，修复任务需要确定预期的访问控制策略——该策略在实践中通常没有文档记录，或散布在业务逻辑中——然后在应用程序源代码的具体上下文中忠实地实现它。

sents.en: Any slight semantic ambiguity or implementation slip, can introduce new logic errors or over-restrict legitimate access.
sents.zh: 任何细微的语义歧义或实现失误，都可能引入新的逻辑错误或过度限制合法访问。

sents.en: (3) Web access-control implementations are heterogeneous, lacking the standardized mechanisms of smart contracts.
sents.zh: (3) Web 访问控制的实现是异构的，缺乏智能体合约那样的标准化机制。

sents.en: In smart contracts, access control centers on a few standardized mechanisms (e.g., msg.sender , the onlyOwner modifier), a regularity that recent smart-contract repair leverages by mining common RBAC practices to guide patch generation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 在智能体合约中，访问控制围绕少数几种标准化机制展开（如 msg.sender、onlyOwner 修饰符），近期智能体合约修复工作正是利用这种规律性，通过挖掘常见的 RBAC 实践来指导补丁生成（Zhang et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Web applications honor no such convention.
sents.zh: Web 应用程序没有遵循这样的惯例。

sents.en: Different applications adopt RBAC, ABAC, or DAC and realize their checks in disparate forms (session variables, database permission tables, or custom validators), with the logic often spread across many files and call layers, so a repair tool cannot rely on a uniform template or prior knowledge to patch accurately across applications.
sents.zh: 不同应用程序采用 RBAC、ABAC 或 DAC，并以不同形式（会话变量、数据库权限表或自定义校验器）实现其检查，逻辑往往分散在多个文件和调用层中，因此修复工具无法依赖统一的模板或先验知识来跨应用程序进行准确的修补。

paragraphs.en: The rapid progress of large language models (LLMs) opens a promising path to this problem and lends fresh hope to repairing complex BAC. Pre-trained on massive code corpora, LLMs command the syntax and semantics of mainstream programming languages and have internalized a wealth of framework idioms, API conventions, and secure-coding practices. Across downstream tasks ranging from resolving real-world repository issues ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) and detecting vulnerabilities ( Ferrag et al., 2025 ) to localizing faults and repairing programs ( Xia et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Hossain et al., 2024 ) and penetration testing ( Deng et al., 2024 ) , they already attain near-expert performance on a range of benchmarks, indicating that LLMs are now broadly capable of handling complex, context-coupled code and security tasks. More importantly, the distinctive strengths of LLMs directly address the core difficulties that have made BAC repair hard. Firstly , rather than matching a fixed syntactic pattern or template rule, an LLM identifies a missing or misconfigured authorization check through a holistic understanding of code semantics, reasoning from the surrounding business logic and thereby overcoming the absence of fixed syntactic or data-flow patterns . Secondly , an LLM can infer implicit access-control intent from code context, variable names, comments, and the implementation of sibling modules in the same project, reconstructing the intended access-control policy even without an explicit specification and thereby deciding what check to add and at what granularity to make the fix correct. Thirdly , having encountered RBAC, ABAC, and DAC models and their heterogeneous realizations, including session variables, permission-table lookups, and custom validation routines, throughout pre-training, an LLM generalizes across applications and languages, adapting to each project’s checking logic without a uniform template or task- specific prior .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速进展为这一问题开辟了一条富有前景的路径，为修复复杂的 BAC 带来了新的希望。 通过在海量代码语料上进行预训练，LLM 掌握了主流编程语言的语法与语义，并内化了大量框架惯用法、API 约定以及安全编码实践。 在从解决真实世界仓库问题（Jimenez et al., 2024）、检测漏洞（Ferrag et al., 2025），到故障定位与程序修复（Xia et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2023; Hossain et al., 2024）以及渗透测试（Deng et al., 2024）等一系列下游任务中，LLM 已在多项基准上达到接近专家的水平，这表明 LLM 现在已普遍具备处理复杂、上下文耦合的代码与安全任务的能力。 更重要的是，LLM 的独特优势恰好切中了使 BAC 修复变得困难的核心难题。 首先，LLM 并非匹配固定的语法模式或模板规则，而是通过对代码语义的整体理解来识别缺失或配置错误的授权检查，并基于周边业务逻辑进行推理，从而克服了固定语法或数据流模式缺失的问题。 其次，LLM 能够从代码上下文、变量名、注释以及同一项目中同级模块的实现推断出隐式的访问控制意图，即使没有显式的规范也能重建预期的访问控制策略，从而决定应添加何种检查以及在何种粒度上进行修复才能使修复正确。 第三，由于在预训练过程中接触过 RBAC、ABAC 和 DAC 模型及其多样化的现实实现（包括会话变量、权限表查找和自定义校验例程），LLM 能够跨应用和跨语言进行泛化，无需统一模板或任务特定先验即可适应每个项目的检查逻辑。

paragraphs.en: This raises the central empirical question: How effective are LLMs at repairing BAC vulnerabilities in web applications?
paragraphs.zh: 这引出了核心的实证问题：大语言模型在修复 Web 应用程序中的 BAC 漏洞方面效果如何？

paragraphs.en: Despite a surge of LLM-based repair over the past two years ( Nong et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Pearce et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , research efforts on BAC in web applications have been lagged behind. Prior efforts either target memory-safety vulnerabilities, exploiting a crash or sanitizer signal to complete a locate-generate-and-validate loop, or, in the smart-contract setting, repair access control by mining standardized RBAC practices to guide the model ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , an approach that does not transfer to the diverse landscape of web applications. LLM-based repair of BAC in web applications thus remains largely unexplored, chiefly for want of a standardized repair benchmark. LLM-based repair research relies on standardized corpora that pair reproducible vulnerabilities with PoCs and ground- truth patches, yet no such BAC dataset exists in either industry or academia. The root difficulty is that BAC is a logic vulnerability whose triggering hinges on runtime context, including session state, role configuration, and initial database contents, and which therefore cannot be faithfully reproduced or tested in a standardized manner without a concrete execution environment. Absent such a benchmark, researchers can neither develop and study repair methods nor compare them fairly on equal footing.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管过去两年基于大语言模型的修复研究激增（Nong et al., 2025；Yu et al., 2025；Pearce et al., 2023；Liu et al., 2024），但针对Web应用中BAC的研究工作仍然滞后。 已有的工作要么针对内存安全漏洞，利用崩溃或净化器信号来完成定位-生成-验证循环，要么在智能合约场景下，通过挖掘标准化的RBAC实践来引导模型进行访问控制修复（Zhang et al., 2025），而这种方法并不适用于多样化的Web应用场景。 因此，基于大语言模型的Web应用BAC修复在很大程度上仍未被探索，主要是因为缺乏标准化的修复基准。 基于大语言模型的修复研究依赖于将可复现漏洞与PoC及基准补丁配对的标准语料库，然而工业界和学术界均不存在这样的BAC数据集。 根本困难在于BAC是一种逻辑漏洞，其触发依赖于运行时上下文，包括会话状态、角色配置和初始数据库内容，因此若没有具体的执行环境，就无法以标准化的方式对其进行忠实的复现或测试。 缺乏这样的基准，研究者既无法开发和研究修复方法，也无法在平等的基础上对它们进行公平比较。

sents.zh: 缺乏这样的基准，研究者既无法开发和研究修复方法，也无法在平等的基础上对它们进行公平比较。

paragraphs.en: To overcome these challenges, we construct BAC-Bench , the first benchmark for BAC repair, consisting of 46 real-world BAC vulnerabilities drawn from six widely used web applications spanning four programming languages (Java, PHP, Go, and Python). Each vulnerability is equipped with a vulnerability description, a textual PoC description, the official patch, a sandboxed runtime environment, a PoC validation program, and a functional test program, enabling faithful reproduction of the vulnerability and dynamic validation of repairs. Building on this benchmark and an in-depth study of real-world BAC patches, we further propose a BAC repair-strategy framework that characterizes any BAC patch along four dimensions, Position, Coverage, Mechanism, and Content, and lays bare its internal construction and strategic choices. We then conduct an extensive evaluation on BAC-Bench with eight base LLMs (DeepSeek-V4 Pro, Qwen3.7-Max, Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, GLM-5.2, MiMo-V2.5 Pro, Kimi K2.7-Code, and Gemini 3.5 Flash) and two commercial closed-source LLM agents (Claude Code and Codex). Our results show that single-turn base LLMs repair only 37.68% of the vulnerabilities on average, whereas two minimal scaffolds, Apply-Feedback and Navigate-and-Locate , raise this average to 66.03%, with Claude Opus 4.8 reaching 75.36%, only 3.63 percentage points below the 78.99% of Claude Code, the best-performing closed-source LLM agent built on the same model. We further find that some LLM-generated patches surpass the official fixes. On CVE-2023-31066, for example, an LLM-generated patch incidentally closed a latent access-control vulnerability that had gone undiscovered for over three years, which we responsibly disclosed to the Apache Software Foundation and the InLong maintainers and which was assigned CVE-2026-63040 ( Apache Software Foundation, 2026 ) . These findings suggest that LLMs can already shoulder part of the BAC repair workload and point to a concrete path toward practical automated BAC repair. All datasets, scaffolds, LLM-generated patches, and experimental scripts are publicly available at https://github.com/TianMaXingK/BAC-BENCH ( Liu, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为克服这些挑战，我们构建了 BAC-Bench，这是首个面向 BAC 修复的基准，包含 46 个来自六个广泛使用的 Web 应用的真实 BAC 漏洞，涵盖四种编程语言（Java、PHP、Go 和 Python）。 每个漏洞都配有漏洞描述、文本形式的 PoC 描述、官方补丁、沙箱化运行环境、PoC 验证程序以及功能测试程序，从而能够忠实地复现漏洞并对修复进行动态验证。 基于该基准以及对真实世界 BAC 补丁的深入研究，我们进一步提出了一个 BAC 修复策略框架，该框架从位置、覆盖范围、机制和内容四个维度刻画任意 BAC 补丁，并揭示其内部构造与策略选择。 随后，我们在 BAC-Bench 上使用八个基础大语言模型（DeepSeek-V4 Pro、Qwen3.7-Max、Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5、GLM-5.2、MiMo-V2.5 Pro、Kimi K2.7-Code 和 Gemini 3.5 Flash）以及两个商业闭源大语言模型智能体（Claude Code 和 Codex）进行了广泛评估。 我们的结果表明，单轮基础大语言模型平均只能修复 37.68% 的漏洞，而两个极简脚手架 Apply-Feedback 和 Navigate-and-Locate 将该平均值提升至 66.03%，其中 Claude Opus 4.8 达到 75.36%，仅比表现最好的闭源大语言模型智能体 Claude Code（基于同一模型构建）的 78.99% 低 3.63 个百分点。 我们进一步发现，一些大语言模型生成的补丁甚至超越了官方修复方案。 例如，在 CVE-2023-31066 上，一个大语言模型生成的补丁意外地修复了一个潜伏超过三年未被发现的访问控制漏洞；我们已负责任地向 Apache 软件基金会和 InLong 维护者披露了该漏洞，并被分配编号 CVE-2026-63040（Apache Software Foundation, 2026）。 这些发现表明，大语言模型已经能够承担部分 BAC 修复工作，并为实现实用的自动化 BAC 修复指明了一条具体路径。 所有数据集、脚手架、大语言模型生成的补丁以及实验脚本均公开 available于 https://github.com/TianMaXingK/BAC-BENCH (Liu, 2026)。

paragraphs.en: In summary, this paper makes the following contributions:

paragraphs.en: A real-world benchmark. We build BAC-Bench , a benchmark of 46 real-world BAC vulnerabilities drawn from six widely used web applications spanning four programming languages (Java, PHP, Go, and Python). Each vulnerability is equipped with a vulnerability description, a textual PoC description, the official patch, a sandboxed runtime environment, a PoC validation program, and a functional test program. We open-source it to facilitate research on BAC repair in web applications.
paragraphs.zh: 一个真实世界基准测试。 我们构建了BAC-Bench，这是一个包含46个真实世界BAC漏洞的基准测试，这些漏洞来自四个编程语言（Java、PHP、Go和Python）的六个广泛使用的Web应用。 每个漏洞都配有漏洞描述、文本版PoC描述、官方补丁、沙箱化运行环境、PoC验证程序以及功能测试程序。 我们将其开源，以促进Web应用中BAC修复的研究。

paragraphs.en: Broken access control (BAC) occurs when a web application fails to enforce authorization, allowing a request to read or modify resources that it is not entitled to access ( OWASP Foundation, 2021 ) . Every web application implicitly follows an intended access-control policy set by its designers or mandated by its business domain, and a BAC vulnerability arises precisely when the access decisions realized by the code diverge from this intended policy. Such divergence takes a family of concrete forms, which are characterized from three complementary perspectives. The first is the granularity at which authorization is missing or incorrect. Following the OWASP API Security Top 10 ( OWASP Foundation, 2023a ) , from coarse to fine, Broken Function-Level Authorization (BFLA) denotes a sensitive endpoint or function that lacks or mis-implements role-based authorization, Broken Object-Level Authorization (BOLA) denotes an attacker manipulating a resource identifier to reach an object owned by another user, a vulnerability widely known as Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR), and Broken Object Property-Level Authorization (BOPLA) denotes access to an object being legitimate while its individual properties that should be off-limits can still be read or written ( OWASP Foundation, 2023b ) . The second perspective is the direction of the privilege violation, which is horizontal when a user reaches a peer’s resources at the same privilege level and vertical when a lower-privilege user acquires higher privileges. The third perspective is the operation the vulnerability enables, which is read-based when it breaches confidentiality through data disclosure and write-based when it breaches integrity through the unauthorized creation, modification, or deletion of state ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . These perspectives are complementary rather than mutually exclusive, and a vulnerability is typically described under all three. For example, tampering with another user’s record through a guessable identifier is a horizontal, write- based BOLA.
paragraphs.zh: 失效的访问控制（BAC）是指Web应用未能实施授权，允许请求读取或修改其无权访问的资源（ OWASP Foundation, 2021 ）。 每个Web应用都隐含地遵循由其设计者设定或由其业务领域规定的预期访问控制策略，而当代码中实现的访问决策偏离这一预期策略时，BAC漏洞便随之产生。 这种偏离表现为一系列具体形式，可以从三个互补的角度加以刻画。 第一个角度是授权缺失或错误的粒度。 依照OWASP API Security Top 10（ OWASP Foundation, 2023a ），从粗到细，失效的函数级授权（BFLA）指缺乏或错误实现了基于角色的授权的敏感端点或函数；失效的对象级授权（BOLA）指攻击者操纵资源标识符以访问属于其他用户的对象，即广为人知的不安全的直接对象引用（IDOR）漏洞；失效的对象属性级授权（BOPLA）指对对象的访问本身是合法的，但其本应受限的各个属性仍可被读取或写入（ OWASP Foundation, 2023b ）。 第二个角度是权限侵犯的方向：当用户访问同一权限级别下同侪的资源时为水平方向，当低权限用户获得更高权限时为垂直方向。 第三个角度是该漏洞所能实现的操作：当其通过数据泄露破坏机密性时为基于读取，当其通过未经授权的状态创建、修改或删除破坏完整性时为基于写入（ Liu et al., 2025 ）。 这些角度是互补而非互斥的，一个漏洞通常需要同时从这三个角度进行描述。 例如，通过可猜测的标识符篡改另一用户的记录，就是一个水平方向的、基于写入的BOLA漏洞。

paragraphs.en: Fundamentally, BAC is a logic vulnerability rather than a syntactic or memory-level one ( Dalton et al., 2009 ) . It exhibits neither a fixed syntactic form nor a traceable data flow, because whether a given access constitutes a violation is inseparable from the application’s high-level business logic and domain semantics ( Sun et al., 2011 ) . An access relation that amounts to a vulnerability in one application may be entirely legitimate behavior in another, as illustrated by OpenEMR’s CVE-2022-2730 ( National Institute of Standards and Technology, 2022 ) , whose fix does not follow the generic IDOR pattern. Moreover, the intended access-control policy of a web application is rarely documented, and the source code is often its only real specification. Compounding this, access-control models and implementation styles differ markedly from one application to the next, both the detection and, especially, the repair of BAC are highly complex, and automated tools struggle to generalize across applications ( Son et al., 2011 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 从根本上说，BAC 是一种逻辑漏洞，而非语法层面或内存层面的漏洞（Dalton et al., 2009）。 它既没有固定的语法形式，也没有可追踪的数据流，因为某次访问是否构成违规，与应用程序的高层业务逻辑和领域语义密不可分（Sun et al., 2011）。 在一个应用程序中构成漏洞的访问关系，在另一个应用程序中可能完全是合法行为，OpenEMR 的 CVE-2022-2730（National Institute of Standards and Technology, 2022）便是一例，其修复方式并不遵循通用的 IDOR 模式。 此外，Web 应用程序预期的访问控制策略很少有文档记录，源代码往往是其唯一真正的规范。 更复杂的是，访问控制模型和实现风格在不同应用程序之间差异显著，BAC 的检测尤其是修复都极为复杂，自动化工具难以跨应用程序泛化（Son et al., 2011；Yuan et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: GenProg ( Le Goues et al., 2011 ) defines a repair as a patch (a set of changes to the program) that makes the patched program pass an entire test suite. The patched program must pass every positive test case, which encodes functionality that must be preserved, and at least one negative test case, which encodes the bug to be fixed. Monperrus ( Monperrus, 2018 ) further articulates the oracles underlying repair, dividing them into the bug oracle , which detects the unexpected behavior, and the regression oracle , which checks that no new bugs are introduced during repair. Building on these notions and on our characterization of BAC above, we define the task of repairing a BAC vulnerability as follows.
paragraphs.zh: GenProg（Le Goues et al., 2011）将修复定义为一个补丁（对程序的一组更改），该补丁使打过补丁的程序通过完整的测试套件。 打过补丁的程序必须通过每个正向测试用例（其编码了必须保留的功能），以及至少一个负向测试用例（其编码了待修复的缺陷）。 Monperrus（Monperrus, 2018）进一步阐明了修复所依据的判定标准，将其分为缺陷判定标准（用于检测异常行为）和回归判定标准（用于检查修复过程中未引入新缺陷）。 基于上述概念以及上面对 BAC 的刻画，我们将修复 BAC 漏洞的任务定义如下。

paragraphs.en: In this section we overview our study, which is designed to answer four research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们概述本研究，该研究旨在回答四个研究问题：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (Effectiveness). How effective are LLMs at repairing BAC vulnerabilities in web applications?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1（有效性）。 大语言模型在修复 Web 应用中的 BAC 漏洞方面有多大效果？

sents.en: RQ1 (Effectiveness).
sents.zh: RQ1（有效性）。

sents.en: How effective are LLMs at repairing BAC vulnerabilities in web applications?
sents.zh: 大语言模型在修复 Web 应用中的 BAC 漏洞方面有多大效果？

paragraphs.en: RQ2 (Limitations and mitigation). What limitations do LLM exhibit when repairing web-application BAC vulnerabilities, and to what extent can these limitations be mitigated?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2（局限性及缓解措施）。 大语言模型在修复Web应用BAC漏洞时表现出哪些局限性，以及这些局限性能在多大程度上得到缓解？

sents.en: RQ2 (Limitations and mitigation).
sents.zh: RQ2（局限性及缓解措施）。

sents.en: What limitations do LLM exhibit when repairing web-application BAC vulnerabilities, and to what extent can these limitations be mitigated?
sents.zh: 大语言模型在修复Web应用BAC漏洞时表现出哪些局限性，以及这些局限性能在多大程度上得到缓解？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (Repair strategy). Which repair-strategy choices underlie the failures of LLM-generated BAC patches?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3（修复策略）。 哪些修复策略的选择是LLM生成的BAC补丁失败的基础？

sents.en: RQ3 (Repair strategy).
sents.zh: RQ3（修复策略）。

sents.en: Which repair-strategy choices underlie the failures of LLM-generated BAC patches?
sents.zh: 哪些修复策略的选择是LLM生成的BAC补丁失败的基础？

paragraphs.en: RQ4 (Comparison with official patches). Are official patches always better than LLM-generated patches?
paragraphs.zh: RQ4（与官方补丁的比较）。 官方补丁总是比LLM生成的补丁更好吗？

sents.en: RQ4 (Comparison with official patches).
sents.zh: RQ4（与官方补丁的比较）。

sents.en: Are official patches always better than LLM-generated patches?
sents.zh: 官方补丁总是比LLM生成的补丁更好吗？

paragraphs.en: To answer them, we conduct a study depicted in Figure 1 . Firstly , we construct BAC-Bench , a dataset of real-world web BAC spanning multiple languages (Java, PHP, Go, and Python), faithfully reflecting the complex access-control implementation patterns of diverse web applications in the wild. Using this benchmark, we systematically evaluate a range of state-of-the-art LLMs and compare their behavior, answering RQ1. Secondly , we analyze the failing LLM-generated patches and find that they fall into two broad failure patterns, namely patch-application failures and semantic failures, which stem largely from LLM hallucination and the limited context window, respectively. We therefore design two minimal scaffolds, Apply-Feedback and Navigate-and-Locate , to mitigate these failures, answering RQ2. Thirdly , through an in-depth study of real-world BAC patches from web applications, we propose a repair-strategy framework that characterizes any BAC patch along four dimensions, Position, Coverage, Mechanism, and Content, and we apply it to the semantically failing patches to identify the dimensions in which their repair strategies go wrong, answering RQ3. Finally , we examine the official patches and evaluate them side by side with the LLM-generated patches under the same dynamic validation protocol, answering RQ4.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答这些问题，我们开展了图1所示的研究。 首先，我们构建了BAC-Bench，一个涵盖多种语言（Java、PHP、Go和Python）的真实世界Web BAC数据集，忠实反映了现实中各类Web应用复杂的访问控制实现模式。 利用该基准，我们系统性地评估了一系列最先进的LLM并比较其行为，回答RQ1。 其次，我们分析了失败的LLM生成补丁，发现它们可归为两大失败模式，即补丁应用失败和语义失败，分别主要源于LLM的幻觉和有限的上下文窗口。 因此，我们设计了两个最小化脚手架Apply-Feedback和Navigate-and-Locate来缓解这些失败，回答RQ2。 第三，通过对Web应用真实世界BAC补丁的深入研究，我们提出了一个修复策略框架，从四个维度刻画任意BAC补丁：位置、覆盖范围、机制和内容，并将其应用于语义失败的补丁，以识别其修复策略出错的维度，回答RQ3。 最后，我们考察了官方补丁，并在相同的动态验证协议下将其与LLM生成的补丁进行并排评估，回答RQ4。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present the design of our study: the methodology for constructing the dataset of BAC-bench (§4.1), the design of validation oracles (§4.2), the selection of LLM models and the experimental setup (§4.3), and the construction of BAC repair-strategy framework (§4.4).
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍研究的设计：BAC-bench 数据集的构建方法（§4.1）、验证预言机的设计（§4.2）、大语言模型的选择与实验设置（§4.3），以及 BAC 修复策略框架的构建（§4.4）。

paragraphs.en: To investigate whether LLMs can automatically repair BAC, we construct a dataset of vulnerabilities from real-world open-source web applications using two complementary sources. The first source consists of BAC vulnerabilities made publicly available through prior research, including the vulnerabilities studied by Huang et al. ( Huang et al., 2024 ) and those discovered by BACFuzz ( Dharmaadi et al., 2025 ) . The second source is obtained by querying the CVE database for records that were disclosed in or after 2017, affect open-source projects hosted on GitHub, provide an official patch or fixing commit, and contain at least one of the following keywords in the CVE record or its associated references: “permission check”, “privilege check”, “access control”, “security check”, “authorization”, “superuser only”, or “admin only”. We then manually review the resulting candidates and remove entries that overlap with the research-derived source or lack a textual description of the exploitation procedure. The resulting dataset comprises 46 BAC vulnerabilities from six projects, namely OpenEMR, Apache InLong, BookWyrm, Nextcloud, Usememos, and XWiki, which are implemented in four programming languages, namely PHP, Java, Go, and Python. Table 1 summarizes the basic characteristics of these applications.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究大语言模型能否自动修复 BAC，我们从两个互补的来源构建了一个来自真实开源 Web 应用的漏洞数据集。 第一个来源包括先前研究公开提供的 BAC 漏洞，其中包括 Huang 等人研究的漏洞 （Huang et al., 2024）以及 BACFuzz 发现的漏洞（Dharmaadi et al., 2025）。 第二个来源是通过查询 CVE 数据库获得的，筛选条件为：披露时间在 2017 年及以后、影响托管在 GitHub 上的开源项目、提供官方补丁或修复提交，并且在 CVE 记录或其关联引用中包含以下关键词中的至少一个：“permission check”（权限检查）、“privilege check”（特权检查）、“access control”（访问控制）、“security check”（安全检查）、“authorization”（授权）、“superuser only”（仅超级用户）或 “admin only”（仅管理员）。 随后，我们人工审查所得的候选条目，并移除与研究来源重复或缺乏漏洞利用过程文字描述的条目。 最终数据集包含来自六个项目的 46 个 BAC 漏洞，即 OpenEMR、Apache InLong、BookWyrm、Nextcloud、Usememos 和 XWiki，它们使用四种编程语言实现，即 PHP、Java、Go 和 Python。 表 1 总结了这些应用的基本特征。

The validity and fidelity of these artifacts thus derive from actual dynamic execution against ground truth, rather than from their authorship.

paragraphs.en: To gauge the true effectiveness of LLM-generated BAC patches, the PoC validation program (e) and the functional test program (f) must themselves be valid and faithful. As a logic vulnerability, BAC lacks the universal sanitizer oracle available for memory-safety bugs. Whereas AddressSanitizer automatically captures out-of-bounds accesses and use-after-free ( Serebryany et al., 2012 ) , the exploitation of a BAC vulnerability triggers neither a crash nor an explicit error. Our oracle design must therefore employ clear decision criteria and satisfy three requirements: it must block the exploit (§4.2.1), preserve legitimate functionality (§4.2.2), and remain replayable (§4.2.3).
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估大语言模型生成的 BAC 补丁的真实有效性，PoC 验证程序（e）和功能测试程序（f）本身必须是有效且可信的。 作为一种逻辑漏洞，BAC 缺少像内存安全漏洞那样可用的通用净化器判定基准（sanitizer oracle）。 AddressSanitizer 能够自动捕获越界访问和释放后使用（Serebryany et al., 2012），而 BAC 漏洞的利用既不会触发崩溃，也不会产生显式错误。 因此，我们的判定基准设计必须采用明确的判定标准，并满足三项要求：它必须阻断漏洞利用（§4.2.1）、保留合法功能（§4.2.2），并且保持可重放性（§4.2.3）。

sents.en: To gauge the true effectiveness of LLM-generated BAC patches, the PoC validation program (e) and the functional test program (f) must themselves be valid and faithful.
sents.zh: 为了评估大语言模型生成的 BAC 补丁的真实有效性，PoC 验证程序（e）和功能测试程序（f）本身必须是有效且可信的。

sents.en: As a logic vulnerability, BAC lacks the universal sanitizer oracle available for memory-safety bugs.
sents.zh: 作为一种逻辑漏洞，BAC 缺少像内存安全漏洞那样可用的通用净化器判定基准（sanitizer oracle）。

sents.en: Whereas AddressSanitizer automatically captures out-of-bounds accesses and use-after-free ( Serebryany et al., 2012 ) , the exploitation of a BAC vulnerability triggers neither a crash nor an explicit error.
sents.zh: AddressSanitizer 能够自动捕获越界访问和释放后使用（Serebryany et al., 2012），而 BAC 漏洞的利用既不会触发崩溃，也不会产生显式错误。

sents.zh: 因此，我们的判定基准设计必须采用明确的判定标准，并满足三项要求：它必须阻断漏洞利用（§4.2.1）、保留合法功能（§4.2.2），并且保持可重放性（§4.2.3）。

paragraphs.en: We design separate vulnerability-blocking oracles for unauthorized reads and unauthorized writes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为未授权读取和未授权写入分别设计了独立的漏洞阻断预言机（oracle）。

paragraphs.en: Unauthorized read. Response-similarity oracles are brittle and prone to false positives due to their fixed similarity thresholds. We instead use a more precise unique-marker content match (honeytoken ( Spitzner, 2003 ) ). A high-entropy, unguessable unique marker is pre-seeded in the victim’s protected resource, and we then assert that the unauthorized attacker’s response contains this marker byte-for-byte. Because the marker is unique and unguessable, its appearance unambiguously proves that an unauthorized read has occurred.
paragraphs.zh: 未授权读取。 基于响应相似性的预言机因其固定的相似度阈值而较为脆弱，且容易产生误报。 我们改用一种更精确的唯一标记内容匹配方法（蜜罐凭证（honeytoken）（Spitzner, 2003））。 我们预先在受害者的受保护资源中植入一个高熵、不可猜测的唯一标记，然后断言未授权攻击者的响应中逐字节地包含该标记。 由于该标记是唯一且不可猜测的，它的出现明确无误地证明了发生了未授权读取。

sents.en: Unauthorized read.
sents.zh: 未授权读取。

sents.en: Response-similarity oracles are brittle and prone to false positives due to their fixed similarity thresholds.
sents.zh: 基于响应相似性的预言机因其固定的相似度阈值而较为脆弱，且容易产生误报。

sents.en: A high-entropy, unguessable unique marker is pre-seeded in the victim’s protected resource, and we then assert that the unauthorized attacker’s response contains this marker byte-for-byte.
sents.zh: 我们预先在受害者的受保护资源中植入一个高熵、不可猜测的唯一标记，然后断言未授权攻击者的响应中逐字节地包含该标记。

sents.zh: 由于该标记是唯一且不可猜测的，它的出现明确无误地证明了发生了未授权读取。

paragraphs.en: Unauthorized write. Unauthorized writes, which include UPDATE, INSERT, and DELETE operations, typically leave no observable trace in the direct response, causing response-similarity oracles to misjudge modification-based violations at a very high rate ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . The classic differential-response oracle ( Zuo et al., 2017 ) can decide only unauthorized reads and cannot automatically decide unauthorized writes. Since our benchmark is white-box with a controllable database, we adopt the more direct database-state inspection as the primary oracle. After the attacker issues an unauthorized write carrying a unique marker, we directly query the victim’s corresponding database row and assert that the marker has been persisted (for UPDATE/DELETE, we additionally assert that the original value has been overwritten or removed). We complement this with a victim-side re-read through the application’s own interface, verifying that the returned content reflects the attacker’s marker. The former observes the committed, persisted state, whereas the latter confirms that the unauthorized write is semantically visible through the application itself.
paragraphs.zh: 未经授权的写入。 未经授权的写入，包括 UPDATE、INSERT 和 DELETE 操作，通常在直接响应中不留下任何可观察的痕迹，导致响应相似性判定器以极高的误判率误判基于修改的违规行为（Liu et al., 2025）。 经典的差分响应判定器（Zuo et al., 2017）只能判定未经授权的读取，无法自动判定未经授权的写入。 由于我们的基准测试是白盒且数据库可控的，我们采用更直接的数据库状态检查作为主要判定器。 在攻击者发出带有唯一标记的未经授权写入后，我们直接查询受害者的相应数据库行，并断言该标记已被持久化（对于 UPDATE/DELETE，我们还额外断言原始值已被覆盖或删除）。 我们还通过应用程序自身接口在受害者端进行重读作为补充，验证返回内容是否反映了攻击者的标记。 前者观察的是已提交的持久化状态，而后者确认该未经授权的写入在应用程序本身中语义上可见。

sents.en: Unauthorized write.
sents.zh: 未经授权的写入。

sents.zh: 我们还通过应用程序自身接口在受害者端进行重读作为补充，验证返回内容是否反映了攻击者的标记。

sents.zh: 前者观察的是已提交的持久化状态，而后者确认该未经授权的写入在应用程序本身中语义上可见。

paragraphs.en: A failed PoC attack alone is insufficient to conclude that a repair succeeds. The patch must also preserve the application’s original legitimate functionality, as required by the preservation condition of Definition 2.2 . In practice, a substantial fraction of patches trade functionality preservation for “passing the PoC” and some even bluntly deny all user access. Although such patches block the attack, they severely violate the application’s business semantics and constitute typical instances of over-restriction , a class of incorrect patches ( Qi et al., 2015 ) . Moreover, a project’s built-in test suite is largely oriented toward general functionality and rarely touches the specific endpoints, operations, and roles involved in the vulnerability at hand. Hence, passing the project suite does not establish that the affected functionality is preserved ( Smith et al., 2015 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 仅有失败的 PoC 攻击不足以断定修复成功。 补丁还必须保留应用程序原有的合法功能，这是定义 2.2 的保留条件所要求的。 在实践中，相当一部分补丁以牺牲功能保留为代价来“通过 PoC”，有些甚至干脆拒绝所有用户访问。 尽管这类补丁阻断了攻击，但它们严重违背了应用程序的业务语义，构成了过度限制（over-restriction）的典型实例，这是一类错误的补丁（Qi et al., 2015）。 此外，项目自带的测试套件主要面向一般功能，很少涉及当前漏洞所涉及的具体端点、操作和角色。 因此，通过项目测试套件并不能证明受影响的功能得到了保留（Smith et al., 2015）。

sents.en: A failed PoC attack alone is insufficient to conclude that a repair succeeds.
sents.zh: 仅有失败的 PoC 攻击不足以断定修复成功。

sents.en: The patch must also preserve the application’s original legitimate functionality, as required by the preservation condition of Definition 2.2 .
sents.zh: 补丁还必须保留应用程序原有的合法功能，这是定义 2.2 的保留条件所要求的。

sents.en: In practice, a substantial fraction of patches trade functionality preservation for “passing the PoC” and some even bluntly deny all user access.
sents.zh: 在实践中，相当一部分补丁以牺牲功能保留为代价来“通过 PoC”，有些甚至干脆拒绝所有用户访问。

sents.en: Although such patches block the attack, they severely violate the application’s business semantics and constitute typical instances of over-restriction , a class of incorrect patches ( Qi et al., 2015 ) .
sents.zh: 尽管这类补丁阻断了攻击，但它们严重违背了应用程序的业务语义，构成了过度限制（over-restriction）的典型实例，这是一类错误的补丁（Qi et al., 2015）。

sents.en: Moreover, a project’s built-in test suite is largely oriented toward general functionality and rarely touches the specific endpoints, operations, and roles involved in the vulnerability at hand.
sents.zh: 此外，项目自带的测试套件主要面向一般功能，很少涉及当前漏洞所涉及的具体端点、操作和角色。

sents.en: Hence, passing the project suite does not establish that the affected functionality is preserved ( Smith et al., 2015 ) .
sents.zh: 因此，通过项目测试套件并不能证明受影响的功能得到了保留（Smith et al., 2015）。

paragraphs.en: Our functionality-preservation oracle therefore adopts a functional test program authored for each BAC. The test targets exactly the functionality affected by the vulnerability and asserts that a legitimate subject that should retain access still succeeds in its legitimate operation both before and after patching. Its decision mechanism follows the same marker-based and database-state checks as the vulnerability-blocking oracle (§4.2.1), with the polarity reversed. If the project ships its own functional tests, we run them together with our targeted test. Otherwise, only ours is run.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们的功能保持判定程序采用为每个 BAC 编写的功能测试程序。 该测试精确针对受漏洞影响的功能，并断言一个应当保留访问权限的合法主体在打补丁前后的合法操作均能成功。 其判定机制遵循与漏洞阻断判定程序（§4.2.1）相同的基于标记和数据库状态的检查，只是判定极性相反。 如果项目自带功能测试，我们会将它们与我们的针对性测试一起运行。 否则，仅运行我们的测试。

sents.en: Our functionality-preservation oracle therefore adopts a functional test program authored for each BAC.
sents.zh: 因此，我们的功能保持判定程序采用为每个 BAC 编写的功能测试程序。

sents.en: The test targets exactly the functionality affected by the vulnerability and asserts that a legitimate subject that should retain access still succeeds in its legitimate operation both before and after patching.
sents.zh: 该测试精确针对受漏洞影响的功能，并断言一个应当保留访问权限的合法主体在打补丁前后的合法操作均能成功。

sents.en: Its decision mechanism follows the same marker-based and database-state checks as the vulnerability-blocking oracle (§4.2.1), with the polarity reversed.
sents.zh: 其判定机制遵循与漏洞阻断判定程序（§4.2.1）相同的基于标记和数据库状态的检查，只是判定极性相反。

sents.en: If the project ships its own functional tests, we run them together with our targeted test.
sents.zh: 如果项目自带功能测试，我们会将它们与我们的针对性测试一起运行。

sents.en: Otherwise, only ours is run.
sents.zh: 否则，仅运行我们的测试。

paragraphs.en: Mutating operations (writes, modifications, or deletions) alter shared application state, making any test program that performs them destructive , i.e., a polluter ( Gyori et al., 2015 ) . Once the mutation footprint of a destructive PoC intersects the verification objects on which another PoC (or its own replay) depends, the latter’s oracle verdict varies with the execution order and becomes a flaky test ( Luo et al., 2014 ) . To eliminate this test-order dependency, we make every destructive PoC hermetic (self-contained) ( Winters et al., 2020 ) . At the start of its execution, the PoC establishes the data it depends on, creating the resource it will later delete and seeding the initial value whose unauthorized modification it will check. Before it exits, it reverts every change it has made to the shared application and restores the pre-run state. Each PoC is thereby idempotent , leaving no residual state and yielding the same verdict regardless of the execution order or the number of repeated runs. PoCs are therefore individually deterministic and mutually non-interfering, which ensures observation independence .
paragraphs.zh: 变异型操作（写入、修改或删除）会改变共享的应用状态，因此执行这类操作的任何测试程序都是破坏性的，即污染者（Gyori et al., 2015）。 一旦某个破坏性 PoC 的变异足迹与另一个 PoC（或其自身重放）所依赖的验证对象相交，后者的预言机判定就会随执行顺序而变化，从而成为不稳定测试（Luo et al., 2014）。 为了消除这种测试顺序依赖，我们使每个破坏性 PoC 都是封闭的（自包含的）（Winters et al., 2020）。 在执行开始时，PoC 会建立其所依赖的数据，创建它稍后将要删除的资源，并植入其将检查未授权修改的初始值。 在退出之前，它会撤销自己对共享应用所做的每一项更改，并恢复运行前的状态。 由此，每个 PoC 都是幂等的，不留下任何残留状态，并且无论执行顺序如何或重复运行多少次，都产生相同的判定。 因此，各 PoC 单独是确定性的，彼此之间互不干扰，从而保证了观察独立性。

paragraphs.en: This work aims to systematically assess the current ability of LLMs to repair BAC vulnerabilities. Accordingly, our criteria for selecting the evaluation targets include advancedness, representativeness, and comparability. We particularly consider SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) , a benchmark that evaluates the coding and program-repair ability of LLMs, and GPQA Diamond ( Rein et al., 2023 ) , a graduate-level reasoning benchmark that targets complex reasoning problems. Our final selection comprises two commercial closed-source general-purpose LLM agents (Claude Code and Codex) and eight base LLMs (DeepSeek-V4 Pro, Qwen3.7-Max, Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, GLM-5.2,Gemini 3.5 Flash, MiMo-V2.5 Pro and Kimi K2.7-Code). Table 2 lists the relevant parameters of these models.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作旨在系统评估大语言模型修复 BAC 漏洞的现有能力。 因此，我们选择评估对象的标准包括先进性、代表性和可比性。 我们特别考虑了 SWE-bench Verified（Jimenez et al., 2024；OpenAI, 2024），一个评估大语言模型编码与程序修复能力的基准，以及 GPQA Diamond（Rein et al., 2023），一个面向复杂推理问题的研究生水平推理基准。 我们的最终选择包括两个商业闭源通用大语言模型智能体（Claude Code 和 Codex）以及八个基础大语言模型（DeepSeek-V4 Pro、Qwen3.7-Max、Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5、GLM-5.2、Gemini 3.5 Flash、MiMo-V2.5 Pro 和 Kimi K2.7-Code）。 表 2 列出了这些模型的相关参数。

paragraphs.en: All LLMs are run under a unified, isolated harness to ensure comparability and evaluation validity.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 LLM 均在统一且隔离的测试框架下运行，以确保可比性和评估有效性。

paragraphs.en: Input. For each vulnerability instance, the model receives the vulnerability description, the textual PoC description (without PoC code), and the source code of the web application (the source granularity varies by category, as detailed below).
paragraphs.zh: 输入。 对于每个漏洞实例，模型接收漏洞描述、文本形式的 PoC 描述（不含 PoC 代码），以及 Web 应用的源代码（源代码粒度因类别而异，详见下文）。

sents.en: Input.

sents.en: For each vulnerability instance, the model receives the vulnerability description, the textual PoC description (without PoC code), and the source code of the web application (the source granularity varies by category, as detailed below).
sents.zh: 对于每个漏洞实例，模型接收漏洞描述、文本形式的 PoC 描述（不含 PoC 代码），以及 Web 应用的源代码（源代码粒度因类别而异，详见下文）。

paragraphs.en: Contamination control. To evaluate the models’ intrinsic repair ability, we disable all network access for the evaluated systems, preventing them from retrieving the official patch, post-fix versions, or any other ground-truth information, and we audit the run log after each inference to confirm that no such information was accessed.
paragraphs.zh: 污染控制。 为了评估模型的内在修复能力，我们禁用被评估系统的所有网络访问，防止其检索官方补丁、修复后版本或任何其他真实标准信息，并在每次推理后审查运行日志，以确认未访问过任何此类信息。

sents.en: Contamination control.
sents.zh: 污染控制。

paragraphs.zh: 会话隔离。 每次运行都会启动一个全新会话，工作目录为空。

paragraphs.en: Repetition. Under identical conditions, we independently repeat the repair of each (model, vulnerability) pair three times to assess stability.
paragraphs.zh: 重复性。 在相同条件下，我们独立重复修复每个（模型，漏洞）对三次，以评估稳定性。

paragraphs.en: The input granularity and the number of interaction turns differ by model category. Base LLMs are queried in a single-turn session, with the source input restricted to the source files modified by the official patch ( Pearce et al., 2023 ) . They must produce a patch in a single response, which we automatically extract from the LLM’s answer via a predefined regular-expression match and materialize as a patch file. The two agents (Claude Code and Codex) instead run their own multi-turn loops, autonomously reading across the entire repository and emitting a patch file. We use them as-is, without altering their internal procedures, and constrain only the outer sandbox (network isolation, session isolation, and log auditing). In addition, we implement two multi-turn scaffolds (§4.3.3) that place base LLMs on an equal footing with the mature LLM agents, i.e., on exactly the same input.
paragraphs.zh: 输入粒度和交互轮数因模型类别而异。 基座 LLM 在单轮会话中进行查询，其源输入被限制为官方补丁所修改的源文件（Pearce et al., 2023）。 它们必须在单次响应中生成一个补丁，我们通过预定义的正则表达式匹配从 LLM 的回答中自动提取该补丁，并将其落地为补丁文件。 两个智能体（Claude Code 和 Codex）则运行各自的多轮循环，自主地读取整个仓库并输出一个补丁文件。 我们按原样使用它们，不改动其内部流程，仅对外层沙箱加以约束（网络隔离、会话隔离和日志审计）。 此外，我们实现了两个多轮脚手架（§4.3.3），使基座 LLM 与成熟的 LLM 智能体处于同等地位，即在完全相同的输入上运行。

paragraphs.en: Beyond single-turn inference, we design two mutually independent scaffolds for base LLMs. Both are minimal, transparent, and deliberately simple, built solely to reveal the core capabilities underlie effective LLM-based BAC repair.
paragraphs.zh: 除了单轮推理之外，我们还为基础大语言模型设计了两个相互独立的支架。 两者都极简、透明且刻意保持简单，其构建的唯一目的是揭示有效的大语言模型 BAC 修复背后的核心能力。

paragraphs.en: LLM-generated patches often fail to apply because their unified-diff metadata, source context, or file paths are inconsistent with the target repository. Such patches cannot reach the subsequent semantic evaluation. To mitigate this application-stage failure, we introduce the Apply-Feedback scaffold.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 生成的补丁经常无法应用，因为其统一差异（unified-diff）元数据、源代码上下文或文件路径与目标仓库不一致。 这样的补丁无法进入后续的语义评估。 为了缓解这一应用阶段的失败，我们引入了 Apply-Feedback 脚手架。

paragraphs.en: The procedure first constructs the initial dialogue context H 0 = InitialPrompt ​ ( d , p , S ) H_{0}=\textsc{InitialPrompt}(d,p,S) from the vulnerability description d d , the PoC description p p , and the source files S S . At turn k k , the LLM receives the current context H k H_{k} and returns a raw textual response o k o_{k} . The scaffold extracts a candidate patch π k = ExtractPatch ​ ( o k ) \pi_{k}=\textsf{ExtractPatch}(o_{k}) and invokes ApplyCheck ​ ( π k , R ) \textsf{ApplyCheck}(\pi_{k},R) to test whether the candidate can be applied to repository R R . The application check uses git apply --check or git apply --recount --check , and returns a Boolean result 𝑜𝑘 k \mathit{ok}_{k} together with the diagnostic e k e_{k} . If 𝑜𝑘 k \mathit{ok}_{k} is true, the candidate patch is returned immediately. Otherwise, the model output and the feedback generated from e k e_{k} are appended to the dialogue context, and the LLM is asked to revise its patch. The process starts at k = 0 k=0 and continues through k = K k=K . Thus, K K , which we set to 5 in our experiments, denotes the maximum number of self-healing attempts after the initial generation, and the LLM is invoked at most K + 1 K+1 times. If no candidate passes the application check, the most recent candidate is returned.

paragraphs.en: Because of their input-size and context limitations, LLMs cannot generally receive an entire repository as input. In the single-turn setting, we therefore follow Pearce et al. ( Pearce et al., 2023 ) and provide the base LLM with only the source files modified by the official patch. This simplification has three drawbacks. First, it does not reflect a realistic repository-level repair scenario and may implicitly reveal the likely repair location. Second, it omits files on which the target files depend, limiting the model’s access to the program semantics needed for a correct repair. Third, it restricts the space of possible repairs, even though a BAC vulnerability may admit multiple valid fixes. In particular, if the official patch is incomplete or defective, the required repair may involve files outside the provided context.
paragraphs.zh: 由于输入规模和上下文长度的限制，大语言模型（LLMs）通常无法将整个代码仓库作为输入接收。 因此，在单轮设置中，我们遵循 Pearce 等人的做法。 （Pearce 等人，2023）仅向基础 LLM 提供由官方补丁修改的源文件。 这种简化有三个缺点。 首先，它无法反映真实的仓库级修复场景，并可能隐式地泄露可能的修复位置。 其次，它省略了目标文件所依赖的文件，限制了模型获取正确修复所需的程序语义。 第三，它限制了可能的修复空间，尽管 BAC 漏洞可能存在多个有效的修复方案。 特别地，如果官方补丁不完整或有缺陷，所需的修复可能涉及所提供上下文之外的文件。

paragraphs.en: To address these issues, we build the Navigate-and-Locate scaffold, thereby restoring the real-world repair scenario, testing the model’s end-to-end ability to locate and repair a vulnerability within a code repository, and aligning the inputs of base LLMs and commercial agents so that they are evaluated on exactly the same input and their true capability gap can be isolated. The scaffold initially provides the repository directory tree and allows the LLM to request source files on demand. At each exploration turn, the LLM receives the current dialogue context H m H_{m} and returns a raw response o m o_{m} . The function ExtractPatch ​ ( o m ) \textsf{ExtractPatch}(o_{m}) checks whether the response contains a patch. If no patch is found, ParseFileRequest ​ ( o m ) \textsf{ParseFileRequest}(o_{m}) identifies the files requested by the model, and Retrieve ​ ( F m , R ) \textsf{Retrieve}(F_{m},R) retrieves their contents from repository R R . The retrieved contents are appended to the dialogue context for the next turn. Exploration continues until the model emits a patch, signals that it has sufficient context, or reaches the exploration budget M M . If no patch is produced during exploration, the scaffold issues one final request for a repair patch based on the files provided so far. The resulting patch is then passed to the downstream application, compilation, and semantic-validation pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们构建了 Navigate-and-Locate 脚手架，从而还原真实世界的修复场景，测试模型在代码仓库中定位并修复漏洞的端到端能力，并使基础大语言模型与商业智能体的输入保持一致，以便它们在完全相同的输入上进行评估，从而能够隔离出两者真实的能力差距。 该脚手架起初提供仓库目录树，并允许大语言模型按需请求源文件。 在每一轮探索中，大语言模型接收当前对话上下文 H m H_{m}，并返回原始响应 o m o_{m}。 函数 ExtractPatch ​ ( o m ) \textsf{ExtractPatch}(o_{m}) 检查该响应是否包含补丁。 如果未找到补丁，ParseFileRequest ​ ( o m ) \textsf{ParseFileRequest}(o_{m}) 会识别模型请求的文件，Retrieve ​ ( F m , R ) \textsf{Retrieve}(F_{m},R) 则从仓库 R R 中检索这些文件的内容。 检索到的内容会被追加到对话上下文中，供下一轮使用。 探索持续进行，直到模型输出补丁、表明其已获得足够的上下文，或达到探索预算 M M。 如果在探索过程中没有产出补丁，脚手架会基于目前提供的文件发出最后一次修复补丁请求。 得到的补丁随后被传递给下游的应用、编译和语义验证流水线。

sents.en: To address these issues, we build the Navigate-and-Locate scaffold, thereby restoring the real-world repair scenario, testing the model’s end-to-end ability to locate and repair a vulnerability within a code repository, and aligning the inputs of base LLMs and commercial agents so that they are evaluated on exactly the same input and their true capability gap can be isolated.
sents.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们构建了 Navigate-and-Locate 脚手架，从而还原真实世界的修复场景，测试模型在代码仓库中定位并修复漏洞的端到端能力，并使基础大语言模型与商业智能体的输入保持一致，以便它们在完全相同的输入上进行评估，从而能够隔离出两者真实的能力差距。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating an access-control patch, whether it originates from a human developer, a traditional program-repair tool, or an LLM, typically reduces to an effectiveness oracle that deems a patch a successful repair if it blocks the proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit and preserves normal functionality under regression testing (Definition 2.2 in §2) ( Pearce et al., 2023 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . This oracle is objective and indispensable, yet opaque. A binary pass/fail verdict treats the patch as a black box, explaining neither how the patch is constructed nor why a rejected patch fails. To open this black box, we introduce the BAC repair-strategy framework , a compact and principled coordinate system that characterizes the internal construction and the strategic choices of a patch for a broken-access-control (BAC) vulnerability.
paragraphs.zh: 评估一个访问控制补丁，无论它来自人类开发者、传统程序修复工具还是大语言模型（LLM），通常都归结为一个有效性判定准则：如果该补丁能够阻止概念验证（PoC）漏洞利用，并在回归测试中保持正常功能，则判定该补丁为成功修复（见第 2 节中的定义 2.2）（Pearce et al., 2023；Jimenez et al., 2024）。 该判定准则客观且不可或缺，但却是不透明的。 二元通过与不通过的判定将补丁视为黑盒，既不解释补丁是如何构造的，也不解释被拒绝的补丁为何失败。 为了打开这个黑盒，我们提出了 BAC 修复策略框架，这是一个紧凑且有原则的坐标系，用于刻画针对越权访问控制（BAC）漏洞的补丁的内部构造与策略选择。

paragraphs.en: Through an in-depth study of a broad set of BAC patches, we observe that repairing a BAC defect essentially amounts to inserting an authorization decision into the program. In the reference architecture standardized by XACML and the earlier IETF policy framework ( OASIS, 2013 ; Yavatkar et al., 2000 ) , an authorization action is decomposed into a Policy Enforcement Point (PEP), which specifies where a request is intercepted and the decision is applied, and a Policy Decision Point (PDP), which specifies what the decision logic is. Refining this anatomy, we contend that any authorization insertion can be characterized by four questions: where it is enforced, how many request paths it covers, how it is implemented, and what authorization decision it makes. This characterization motivates a four-dimensional framework for BAC repair strategies, comprising Position , Coverage , Mechanism , and Content , which locate a patch within the complete repair space.
paragraphs.zh: 通过对大量 BAC 补丁的深入研究，我们观察到修复一个 BAC 缺陷本质上等同于在程序中插入一个授权决策。 在由 XACML 和更早的 IETF 策略框架标准化的参考架构中（OASIS, 2013；Yavatkar et al., 2000），一个授权动作被分解为策略执行点（PEP）和策略决策点（PDP），前者规定在哪里拦截请求并应用决策，后者规定决策逻辑是什么。 进一步细化这一解剖结构，我们认为任何授权插入都可以由四个问题来刻画：在哪里执行、覆盖多少条请求路径、如何实现，以及做出什么授权决策。 这一刻画引出了一个面向 BAC 修复策略的四维框架，包含位置、覆盖、机制和内容，用于将一个补丁定位于完整的修复空间中。

paragraphs.en: Position describes where an access-control check is enforced in a web application, including its logical architectural layer, its placement along the vulnerable execution path, and whether that location serves as a centralized chokepoint. The choice of architectural layer captures the depth of the repair, while the degree of centralization shapes its potential reach and granularity. A check placed at an upstream, centralized point may govern multiple downstream vulnerability units, whereas a check embedded in operation-specific business logic can provide more focused protection. Neither placement is inherently preferable. The appropriate choice depends on the structure of the vulnerability and the desired balance between broad reach and operation-specific precision. Position thus concerns the placement and potential scope of a repair. The protection actually realized across vulnerability units and attack paths is captured by Coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 位置描述访问控制检查在Web应用中被强制执行的位置，包括其所在的逻辑架构层、在易受攻击执行路径上的摆放位置，以及该位置是否作为集中式咽喉点。 架构层的选择体现了修复的深度，而集中化程度则决定了修复的潜在覆盖范围与粒度。 放置在上游集中点的检查可以管控多个下游漏洞单元，而嵌入在特定操作业务逻辑中的检查则能提供更有针对性的保护。 两种放置方式本身并无优劣之分。 合适的选择取决于漏洞的结构，以及在广泛覆盖与特定操作精度之间所期望的平衡。 因此，位置关注的是修复的放置位置及其潜在影响范围。 在漏洞单元和攻击路径上实际实现的保护效果则由覆盖度来刻画。

sents.zh: 在漏洞单元和攻击路径上实际实现的保护效果则由覆盖度来刻画。

paragraphs.en: Coverage captures the scope of protection both across vulnerability units sharing the same root cause within a single BAC and across attack paths reaching each unit. The units may correspond, for example, to the read, update, and delete operations on the same protected object, or to a group of sibling endpoints implementing related functionality. A single unit may in turn be reachable through multiple attack paths, such as distinct request routes, request sequences, or input conditions that eventually trigger the same vulnerable operation. Coverage therefore records the breadth of a repair, reflecting whether a patch protects all vulnerability units sharing the root cause and blocks every attack path through which those units can be reached.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖率刻画的是保护范围，既包括同一 BAC 内共享同一根因的各漏洞单元之间的覆盖，也包括到达每个单元的各攻击路径的覆盖。 这些单元可以对应于例如对同一受保护对象的读取、更新和删除操作，或者对应于实现相关功能的一组同类端点。 单个单元本身又可能通过多条攻击路径到达，例如不同的请求路由、请求序列或最终触发同一漏洞操作的输入条件。 因此，覆盖率记录的是修复的广度，反映补丁是否保护了共享该根因的所有漏洞单元，并阻断了到达这些单元的每条攻击路径。

paragraphs.en: Mechanism specifies how the check is implemented, whether by reusing a canonical authorization helper already present in the codebase, by hand-rolling a bespoke check function in the application code, or by adding an extra filtering predicate to the SQL query at the data layer. These choices carry different trade-offs. Reusing a helper keeps the codebase consistent and is less error-prone, hand-rolling a dedicated check adds complexity and is more prone to omissions, and a query-level predicate is a fine-grained modification that demands precise handling.
paragraphs.zh: 机制规定了权限检查的具体实现方式——是复用代码库中已有的规范授权辅助函数，还是在应用代码中手工编写一个定制的检查函数，或是在数据层的 SQL 查询中添加一个额外的过滤谓词。 这些选择各有不同的权衡。 复用辅助函数能保持代码库的一致性且不易出错，手工编写专门的检查函数会增加复杂度且更容易出现遗漏，而查询级别的谓词则是一种细粒度的修改，需要精确处理。

paragraphs.en: Content concerns what the check decides, which is tightly coupled to the concrete business scenario. It can be viewed as an explicit rendering of the intended policy the application designs for that scenario, shaped by the access-control model it follows, whether ownership/DAC, role/RBAC, attribute/ABAC, or relationship/ReBAC ( Sandhu et al., 1996 ; Hu et al., 2014 ; Fong, 2011 ) . Its granularity ranges from coarse, role-level discrimination to fine, per-object ownership.
paragraphs.zh: 内容涉及该检查所判定的事项，与具体业务场景紧密耦合。 它可以被看作是应用为该场景所设计意图策略的显式呈现，其形态受其采用的访问控制模型影响，无论是所有权/DAC、角色/RBAC、属性/ABAC 还是关系/ReBAC（Sandhu 等，1996；Hu 等，2014；Fong，2011）。 其粒度从粗粒度的角色级区分到细粒度的逐对象所有权不等。

sents.zh: 内容涉及该检查所判定的事项，与具体业务场景紧密耦合。

paragraphs.en: The conceptual framework is not directly observable clearly without additional coding rules. To apply it consistently to thousands of repository-level patches, we operationalize each dimension as an observable variable with explicit and reproducible boundaries. The operationalization uses two stages. First, each patch receives a fine-grained label that preserves its concrete repair strategy and failure mode. Then, the fine-grained label is mapped to a binary outcome for quantitative comparison across models, applications, vulnerabilities, and experimental conditions. Table 3 summarizes this coding scheme.

paragraphs.en: Position identifies the logical architectural location at which a patch introduces or modifies an authorization enforcement decision. Drawing on established presentation-domain-data layering ( Fowler, 2002 ) and recent empirical evidence on controller-service-repository architectures ( Özkan et al., 2023 ) , and informed by our analysis of BAC patches in web applications, we classify repair locations into five logical categories: Presentation, Control, Business, Data, and Cross-Cutting Authorization. The presentation layer handles rendering and final output. The control layer receives external requests, parses inputs, establishes request context, and selects an entry point. The business layer executes domain operations and workflow logic. The data layer reads, filters, updates, and persists application data. The cross-cutting authorization layer contains ACL, RBAC, policy, or other centralized authorization infrastructure. The authorization layer is treated as a cross-cutting concern rather than as a fifth sequential runtime layer. A Position is accurate only when the patch modifies the actual execution path of the vulnerable request and the check is placed at a time that can constrain the sensitive operation or reliably compensate for its effect. For a multi-point patch, any path-level or temporal misalignment causes the Position result to be classified as a failure.
paragraphs.zh: Position（位置）标识补丁引入或修改授权执行决策所在的逻辑架构位置。 借鉴已有的表示层—领域层—数据层分层结构（Fowler, 2002）、近期关于控制器—服务—仓库架构的实证证据（Özkan et al., 2023），并结合我们对 Web 应用中 BAC 补丁的分析，我们将修复位置划分为五个逻辑类别：表示层、控制层、业务层、数据层和横切授权层。 表示层负责渲染和最终输出。 控制层接收外部请求、解析输入、建立请求上下文并选择入口点。 业务层执行领域操作和工作流逻辑。 数据层读取、过滤、更新并持久化应用数据。 横切授权层包含 ACL、RBAC、策略或其他集中式授权基础设施。 授权层被视为横切关注点，而非第五个顺序运行时层。 只有当补丁修改了易受攻击请求的实际执行路径，且检查被放置在能够约束敏感操作或可靠补偿其影响的时机时，Position 才是准确的。 对于多点补丁，任何路径层面或时机上的不一致都会导致 Position 结果被判定为失败。

paragraphs.en: Coverage is quantified using the ratio k / n k/n . Before inspecting candidate patches, we manually enumerate and freeze n n of each BAC based on the vulnerability description, disclosure material, and target-version source code. To make large-scale annotation tractable and reproducible, we consider only the attack path that is explicitly documented in the vulnerability description for each BAC and do not separately enumerate or score alternative attack paths. The values of n n for all vulnerabilities are reported in Appendix C . Here, k k is the number of frozen units that receive a structural security intervention from the patch. Coverage is classified as complete when k = n k=n and incomplete when k < n k<n . This dimension does not evaluate whether the authorization condition on a covered path is correct.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖率使用比值 k/n k/n 来量化。 在检查候选补丁之前，我们根据漏洞描述、披露材料以及目标版本的源代码，人工枚举并冻结每个 BAC 的 n n 个单元。 为了使大规模标注切实可行且可复现，我们只考虑每个 BAC 在漏洞描述中明确记录的攻击路径，而不单独枚举或评分其他备选攻击路径。 所有漏洞的 n n 值在附录 C 中报告。 这里，k k 是补丁对其施加了结构性安全干预的已冻结单元的数量。 当 k = n k=n 时，覆盖率被分类为完全；当 k < n k<n 时，覆盖率被分类为不完全。 该维度并不评估被覆盖路径上的授权条件是否正确。

paragraphs.en: Mechanism is classified into four fine-grained categories. Standard mechanism reuse refers to the correct use of an existing central ACL, authorization helper, security-aware query, or other project security facility. A reliable project-native mechanism does not directly reuse a standard helper but derives the decision from trusted principals, authoritative resources, stable APIs, and fail-closed control flow in a manner compatible with the application architecture. These two categories are mapped to mechanism success. A fragile substitute mechanism relies on proxy attributes, unstable internal state, or an inappropriate mechanism family. Mechanism implementation failure includes incorrect APIs, types, queries, cache handling, exception propagation, or control flow that prevents the decision from being reliably enforced. These last two categories are mapped to mechanism failure.
paragraphs.zh: 机制被划分为四个细粒度类别。 标准机制复用是指正确使用已有的中央 ACL、授权辅助器、安全感知查询或其他项目安全设施。 可靠的项目原生机制不直接复用标准辅助器，而是以与应用架构兼容的方式，从可信主体、权威资源、稳定 API 和故障关闭（fail-closed）控制流中得出决策。 这两个类别映射为机制成功。 脆弱的替代机制依赖代理属性、不稳定的内部状态或不合适的机制族。 机制实现失败包括错误的 API、类型、查询、缓存处理、异常传播或控制流，导致决策无法被可靠地执行。 这后两个类别映射为机制失败。

sents.zh: 机制被划分为四个细粒度类别。

paragraphs.en: Content is classified as correct , partially correct , or incorrect . A patch is correct when it expresses the target allowed set, blocks unauthorized access, and preserves legitimate functionality. It is partially correct when it blocks the core unauthorized access and retains basic legitimate authorization, but exhibits a bounded deviation in administrator exceptions, action granularity, relationship direction, boundary inputs, or the complete allowed set. It is incorrect when the subject, resource, action, core relationship, or security effect is wrong, or when the patch does not express a meaningful authorization decision. Under the strict binary mapping used in this study, only correct counts as Content success. Both partially correct and incorrect count as Content failures. We retain the three-way labels in the detailed analysis because they distinguish bounded semantic deviations from fundamentally incorrect repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 内容被分类为正确、部分正确或不正确。 当补丁表达了目标允许集合、阻止了未授权访问并保留了合法功能时，即为正确。 当补丁阻止了核心的未授权访问并保留了基本的合法授权，但在管理员例外、动作粒度、关系方向、边界输入或完整允许集合方面存在有界限的偏差时，即为部分正确。 当主体、资源、动作、核心关系或安全效果错误，或补丁未表达出有意义的授权决策时，即为不正确。 在本研究采用的严格二值映射下，只有正确才算作内容成功。 部分正确和不正确都算作内容失败。 我们在详细分析中保留三分类标签，因为它们能够区分有界限的语义偏差与根本错误的修复。

paragraphs.en: We use the BAC repair-strategy framework to conduct an in-depth analysis of patches for BAC vulnerabilities. Recent studies suggest that LLMs can serve as reliable labeling instruments for software-engineering artifacts when guided by explicit coding rules ( Ahmed et al., 2025 ) . In patch evaluation, rubric-guided LLM judgments have achieved agreement with human consensus comparable to that of human raters ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , while LLM-generated labels for commit classification have approached inter-human agreement ( Wan et al., 2026 ) . Guided by the four-dimensional criteria in Table 3 , we therefore use an LLM to analyze each BAC patch and assign fine-grained labels, which are subsequently converted into binary outcomes using the deterministic mappings in the same table. To assess labeling reliability, three PhD students specializing in cybersecurity independently relabel a stratified random sample using the same coding rules while blinded to the LLM labels and to each other’s judgments. We report both human inter-rater agreement and the agreement between the LLM labels and the human consensus using percent agreement and Cohen’s κ \kappa in §5.3.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 BAC 修复策略框架对 BAC 漏洞的补丁进行深入分析。 近期研究表明，在明确的编码规则指导下，大语言模型可以作为软件工程制品的可靠标注工具（Ahmed et al., 2025）。 在补丁评估方面，基于评分标准的大语言模型判断与人类共识的一致性已可与人类评分者相媲美（Shi et al., 2026），而在提交分类方面，大语言模型生成的标签已接近人际一致性水平（Wan et al., 2026）。 因此，在表 3 中四维标准的指导下，我们使用大语言模型分析每个 BAC 补丁并分配细粒度标签，随后利用同一表中的确定性映射将这些标签转换为二元结果。 为评估标注的可靠性，三名专攻网络安全的博士生在不知晓大语言模型标签以及彼此判断的情况下，使用相同的编码规则独立地对分层随机样本进行重新标注。 我们在 §5.3 中使用一致百分比和 Cohen's κ 报告人类评分者之间的一致性，以及大语言模型标签与人类共识之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: The eight base LLMs exhibit substantial performance heterogeneity. Among the eight base LLMs, the four closed-source models achieve a mean effectiveness of 40.04 % 40.04\% , compared with 35.33 % 35.33\% for the four open-weight models. paragraphs.en: To answer RQ2, we analyze at which stage an ineffective patch fails. Application of a patch is a prerequisite for the two behavioral tests, yet passing git apply verifies only format compliance rather than whether the patch repairs the vulnerability. The PoC and functional tests instead evaluate the intended access-control behavior and preserved functionality required by Definition 2.2 . We therefore distinguish Patch-Application Failures , which occur at the application stage, from BAC Semantic Failures , which surface in the PoC or functional tests. §5.2.1 examines the former and their mitigation through the Apply-Feedback scaffold, while §5.2.2 examines the latter and the mitigation provided by Navigate-and-Locate .
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答 RQ2，我们分析无效补丁在哪个阶段失败。 补丁能否应用是两项行为测试的前提条件，然而通过 git apply 仅能验证格式合规性，而无法验证补丁是否修复了漏洞。 PoC 测试和功能测试评估的则是定义 2.2 所要求的预期访问控制行为以及被保留的功能。 因此，我们将发生在应用阶段的「补丁应用失败」与在 PoC 或功能测试中显现的「BAC 语义失败」区分开来。§5.2.1 考察前者及其通过 Apply-Feedback 脚手架实现的缓解措施，而 §5.2.2 考察后者以及 Navigate-and-Locate 所提供的缓解措施。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 shows that patch application is a substantial failure point for single-turn base LLM repair. Across the eight base LLMs, the macro-average applicability is only 62.50 % 62.50\% , meaning that 37.50 % 37.50\% of the generated patches fail before reaching PoC or functional evaluation. The problem is particularly severe for Claude Opus 4.8, whose applicability is 42.03 % 42.03\% . An inapplicable patch cannot be materialized in the target repository, so its intended BAC repair remains unobservable through the downstream behavioral tests.

paragraphs.en: We manually inspected patches that failed to apply and identified several recurring patch-application failure patterns. These included hunk-header range/count mismatches, malformed hunk-header syntax, hunk-context mismatches, and patch-path resolution failures. There were also cases in which generated patches contained explanatory prose, ellipses, or message headers as non-comment text. Case A (Figures 2 ) and Case B (Figures 3 ) respectively present representative examples, and Case C and Case D are provided in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们人工检查了应用失败的补丁，并识别出若干反复出现的补丁应用失败模式。 这些模式包括 hunk 头部范围/计数不匹配、hunk 头部语法格式错误、hunk 上下文不匹配，以及补丁路径解析失败。 还有一些情况是生成的补丁中包含解释性文字、省略号或消息头等非注释文本。 情形 A（图 2）和情形 B（图 3）分别给出了具有代表性的示例，情形 C 和情形 D 则见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2 , Case A exemplifies the hunk-header range/count mismatch pattern. The Qwen3.7-Max patch for OpenEMR’s CVE-2022-2730 declares " -74,8 +83,13 " in its hunk header. The header specifies 8 old-file lines and 13 new- file lines, whereas the hunk body actually contains 9 old-file lines and 16 new-file lines. Although the hunk contains a plausible authorization check and a query restriction, this mismatch causes git apply to reject the file as a corrupt patch. The case shows that a locally meaningful repair remains unevaluable when its diff metadata is invalid. Case B corresponding to Figure 3 shows malformed hunk-header syntax. The Opus4.8 patch for Usememos’ CVE-2022-4684 writes the hunk header as func (s *Server) registerMemoRoutes(...) , omitting the old-file and new-file ranges required by the unified-diff format. Consequently, git apply reports unrecognized input . Although the output conveys a human-readable source location, it is not a well-formed patch that git apply can consume.

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these cases show that many Patch-Application Failures stem not from misguided repair strategies but from hallucinated diff metadata. When reconstructing a diff over hundreds of lines, an LLM may misremember hunk ranges, contextual lines, or path prefixes that git apply rejects deterministically. This failure mode is therefore an application-stage bottleneck distinct from BAC authorization reasoning, and it should be recoverable once the model sees the tool’s diagnostics. To test this, we evaluate the Apply-Feedback scaffold (Algorithm 1 ), which applies the generated patch to the target repository and feeds the diagnostics from git apply back to the base LLM for revision.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些案例表明，许多补丁应用失败并非源于错误的修复策略，而是源于幻觉的 diff 元数据。 在重建覆盖数百行的 diff 时，LLM 可能会记错 hunk 范围、上下文行或路径前缀，而 git apply 会确定性地拒绝这些错误。 因此，这种失败模式是一个区别于 BAC 授权推理的应用阶段瓶颈，并且一旦模型看到工具的诊断信息，它应当是可恢复的。 为验证这一点，我们评估了 Apply-Feedback 脚手架（算法 1），它将生成的补丁应用到目标仓库，并把 git apply 的诊断信息反馈给基础 LLM 以进行修订。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 reports the effect of the Apply-Feedback scaffold. The macro-average applicability rate increases from 62.50 % 62.50\% under the Base LLM condition to 96.11 % 96.11\% under Apply-Feedback, an improvement of 33.61 33.61 percentage points. All eight models show substantial gains. Claude Opus 4.8 exhibits the largest increase, from 42.03 % 42.03\% to 96.38 % 96.38\% , while GPT-5.5 reaches 100.00 % 100.00\% applicability. These results show that Base LLMs can produce applicable repository patches in most cases when they receive direct feedback from the patch-application tool.

paragraphs.en: The higher applicability is accompanied by higher downstream behavioral-test rates. The macro-average PoC pass rate rises from 42.75 % 42.75\% to 56.88 % 56.88\% , and the functional-test pass rate rises from 49.46 % 49.46\% to 77.45 % 77.45\% . These increases partly reflect the fact that more patches become eligible for behavioral evaluation once the application barrier is reduced. The macro-average final effectiveness nevertheless increases by only 13.50 13.50 percentage points, from 37.68 % 37.68\% to 51.18 % 51.18\% , which is substantially smaller than the gain of 33.61 33.61 percentage points in applicability. This gap indicates that Apply-Feedback primarily mitigates Patch-Application Failures. It does not by itself eliminate BAC Semantic Failures or resolve the underlying difficulty of constructing semantically correct BAC repairs.

Under the Apply-Feedback condition, the macro-average applicability rate reaches 96.11 % 96.11\% , whereas the PoC-based security-test and functional-test pass rates are 56.88 % 56.88\% and 77.45 % 77.45\% , respectively. paragraphs.en: We manually audited patches that passed application-stage validation but failed at least one of the two dynamic validation tests. The main failure patterns were semantic-contract misunderstandings, incomplete authorization-state reconstruction, enforcement-point mislocalization, and symptom-level repairs. These patterns show that BAC repair requires repository-level reasoning about data definitions, call relationships, request handlers, authorization state, and state-transition logic rather than local code generation alone. Case E (Figures 5 ) presents a representative example, and Case F and Case G are provided in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们人工审查了通过应用阶段验证但未通过两项动态验证测试中至少一项的补丁。 主要的失败模式包括语义契约理解偏差、授权状态重建不完整、执行点定位错误以及症状级修复。 这些模式表明，BAC 修复需要对数据定义、调用关系、请求处理器、授权状态和状态转移逻辑进行仓库级推理，而不能仅依赖局部代码生成。 案例 E（图 5）给出了一个代表性示例，案例 F 和案例 G 见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 presents Case E, an instance of the semantic-contract misunderstanding pattern. The Kimi K2.7-Code patch for XWiki’s CVE-2021-32620 checks userObject.getIntValue("disabled", 0) == 1 before re-enabling the account. In the target XWiki version, however, the account state is represented by the active property, and an account is disabled when active = 0 . The relevant contract is defined by XWikiUser.ACTIVE_PROPERTY in XWikiUser.java . That file is not modified by the official patch and was therefore not included in the source context provided under the Base LLM and Apply-Feedback conditions. Consequently, the model had no direct access to the actual field definition when generating the repair and had to infer the property name from incomplete context. The resulting patch uses a nonexistent or semantically incorrect field, so its check does not take effect as intended. This case illustrates how source-context restrictions can prevent an LLM from recovering the correct data-field contract.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 展示了案例 E，这是语义契约误解模式的一个实例。 Kimi K2.7-Code 针对 XWiki 的 CVE-2021-32620 的补丁在重新启用账户前会检查 userObject.getIntValue("disabled", 0) == 1。 然而，在目标 XWiki 版本中，账户状态由 active 属性表示，当 active = 0 时账户处于禁用状态。 相关契约由 XWikiUser.java 中的 XWikiUser.ACTIVE_PROPERTY 定义。 该文件未被官方补丁修改，因此在 Base LLM 和 Apply-Feedback 条件下提供的源上下文中并未包含该文件。 因此，该模型在生成修复时无法直接访问实际的字段定义，只能从不完整的上下文中推断属性名。 最终生成的补丁使用了不存在或语义错误的字段，因此其检查未能按预期生效。 该案例说明了源上下文限制如何导致大语言模型无法恢复正确的数据字段契约。

paragraphs.en: These cases expose the limitations of restricting the Base LLM’s source context to the pre-patch source files touched by the official patch, thereby hindering the LLM’s reconstruction of the relevant application logic and authorization semantics. To assess whether repository-level source exploration can mitigate these BAC Semantic Failures, we evaluate the Navigate-and-Locate scaffold introduced in § 4.3.3 and formalized in Algorithm 2 . The scaffold exposes the repository tree and allows the LLM to request source files on demand. We compose it with Apply-Feedback and report the results for the resulting combined condition in Table 6 . The macro-average final effectiveness increases from 51.18 % 51.18\% under Apply-Feedback to 66.03 % 66.03\% , a gain of 14.86 14.86 percentage points. Relative to the Base LLM condition, the combined scaffolds improve final effectiveness by 28.35 28.35 percentage points. The largest improvement occurs for the PoC-based security test, whose macro-average pass rate rises from 56.88 % 56.88\% to 72.37 % 72.37\% , an increase of 15.49 15.49 percentage points. In contrast, the functional-test pass rate increases only from 77.45 % 77.45\% to 78.35 % 78.35\% , a change of 0.91 0.91 percentage points. The combined condition also has a slightly lower macro-average applicability rate than Apply-Feedback, decreasing from 96.11 % 96.11\% to 93.39 % 93.39\% .

paragraphs.en: Seven of the eight models improve under the combined condition. Claude Opus 4.8 achieves the highest final effectiveness at 75.36 % 75.36\% , followed by GPT-5.5 at 73.19 % 73.19\% and Qwen3.7-Max at 71.01 % 71.01\% . Claude Opus 4.8’s 75.36 % 75.36\% is only 3.63 3.63 percentage points below the 78.99 % 78.99\% achieved by Claude Code, a closed-source agent based on Opus 4.8, while GPT-5.5’s 73.19 % 73.19\% is 3.62 3.62 percentage points below the 76.81 % 76.81\% achieved by Codex, a closed-source agent based on GPT-5.5. Claude Opus 4.8 is particularly illustrative and exhibits the largest absolute gain among the eight Base LLMs. Its final effectiveness rises from 30.43 % 30.43\% in the file-restricted Base LLM condition to 75.36 % 75.36\% under the combined scaffold, an increase of 44.93 44.93 percentage points. This result shows not only that providing sufficient repository context and interaction can substantially improve an LLM’s understanding of the BAC vulnerability, the relevant application logic, and its access-control semantics, thereby enabling more effective repository-level repairs, but also that the two lightweight scaffolds introduced in this work can substantially improve Base LLM repair effectiveness and mitigate the limitations.

sents.en: This result shows not only that providing sufficient repository context and interaction can substantially improve an LLM’s understanding of the BAC vulnerability, the relevant application logic, and its access-control semantics, thereby enabling more effective repository-level repairs, but also that the two lightweight scaffolds introduced in this work can substantially improve Base LLM repair effectiveness and mitigate the limitations.
sents.zh: 这一结果不仅表明提供充分的仓库上下文和交互能够显著提升大语言模型对 BAC 漏洞、相关应用逻辑及其访问控制语义的理解，从而实现更有效的仓库级修复，还表明本文引入的两个轻量级脚手架能够显著提升基础大语言模型的修复效果并缓解其局限性。

paragraphs.en: Grouping the models into closed-source and open-weight categories, the combined condition also reveals a consistent advantage for the evaluated closed-source models. The four evaluated closed-source Base LLMs achieve a mean final effectiveness of 71.01 % 71.01\% , compared with 61.05 % 61.05\% for the four evaluated open-weight Base LLMs, a difference of 9.96 9.96 percentage points.

paragraphs.en: The PoC-based security test and the functional test can determine whether a patch exhibits the desired behavior on the tested scenarios, but they cannot explain why a semantically failing patch fails or which aspect of its repair strategy is responsible. We therefore apply the BAC Repair-Strategy Framework defined in § 4.4 to characterize the observable failure dimensions of LLM-generated patches.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 PoC 的安全测试和功能测试可以判断补丁在所测场景中是否表现出预期行为，但它们无法解释语义上失败的补丁为何失败，也无法说明是其修复策略的哪个方面导致的。 因此，我们应用 § 4.4 中定义的 BAC 修复策略框架来刻画 LLM 生成的补丁的可观察失败维度。
