sents.en: We therefore apply the BAC Repair-Strategy Framework defined in § 4.4 to characterize the observable failure dimensions of LLM-generated patches.
sents.zh: 因此，我们应用 § 4.4 中定义的 BAC 修复策略框架来刻画 LLM 生成的补丁的可观察失败维度。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 reports the four-dimensional failure prevalence among all 2,735 2{,}735 LLM-generated patches that pass application and build validation. Across all of these patches, Content has the highest failure prevalence at 23.44 % 23.44\% , followed by Mechanism at 18.21 % 18.21\% , Coverage at 10.60 % 10.60\% , and Position at 6.00 % 6.00\% . This ordering indicates that the dominant limitation lies in reconstructing or expressing the complete authorization policy required by the target business scenario and in implementing that policy through a reliable, project-compatible mechanism, rather than in identifying a plausible repair location.
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 报告了全部 2,735 个通过应用与构建验证的 LLM 生成补丁中四维失效的普遍程度。 在所有这些补丁中，Content 的失效占比最高，为 23.44%，其次是 Mechanism 为 18.21%，Coverage 为 10.60%，Position 为 6.00%。 这一排序表明，主要局限在于重构或表达目标业务场景所需的完整授权策略，以及通过可靠且与项目兼容的机制来实现该策略，而非在于找到一个看似合理的修复位置。

paragraphs.en: Under the Base condition, Content is the most prevalent failure dimension for six of the eight LLMs, whereas Mechanism is more prevalent for GPT-5.5 and MiMo-V2.5 Pro, and Position is the least prevalent failure dimension. The model-level profiles reveal distinct failure tendencies. GPT-5.5 has the lowest Content failure prevalence among the Base LLMs at 14.91 % 14.91\% , although its Mechanism failure prevalence remains 19.30 % 19.30\% . This profile indicates a relative advantage in reconstructing the intended authorization relationship, but not necessarily in implementing it through the application’s existing security facilities. Kimi K2.7-Code has the lowest Position and Coverage failure prevalences, both at 1.45 % 1.45\% , suggesting that its patches less frequently target unrelated locations or omit structurally related vulnerability units. Its Mechanism and Content failure prevalences remain 15.94 % 15.94\% and 21.74 % 21.74\% , respectively, showing that broad structural coverage does not guarantee a correct authorization policy or a reliable enforcement mechanism. Claude Opus 4.8 has the lowest Mechanism failure prevalence among the Base LLMs at 9.09 % 9.09\% , together with a low Position failure prevalence of 1.82 % 1.82\% , but its Content failure prevalence remains 21.82 % 21.82\% . MiMo-V2.5 Pro has the highest Coverage, Mechanism, and Content failure prevalences among the Base LLMs, at 20.90 % 20.90\% , 32.84 % 32.84\% , and 31.34 % 31.34\% , respectively. These profiles show that the models do not fail uniformly. Some more often reconstruct a plausible authorization policy but implement it unreliably, whereas others more frequently omit related vulnerability units or fail to recover the required policy semantics.

paragraphs.en: The experimental conditions further clarify the roles of the two scaffolds. Under the Base LLM condition, the failure prevalences are 4.98 % 4.98\% for Position, 11.13 % 11.13\% for Coverage, 19.93 % 19.93\% for Mechanism, and 23.59 % 23.59\% for Content. Under Apply-Feedback , the corresponding values increase to 9.27 % 9.27\% , 16.59 % 16.59\% , 27.16 % 27.16\% , and 31.57 % 31.57\% . This increase should not be interpreted as evidence that Apply-Feedback worsens semantic repair. The scaffold increases the number of patches that pass application and build validation from 602 602 to 928 928 , thereby admitting patches that would otherwise have been excluded by Patch-Application Failures. The newly admitted patches can contain weaker semantic repairs, which raises the observed prevalence of semantic defects.
paragraphs.zh: 实验条件进一步阐明了这两个脚手架的作用。 在基础大语言模型条件下，位置类失败率为 4.98 % 4.98\%，覆盖类为 11.13 % 11.13\%，机制类为 19.93 % 19.93\%，内容类为 23.59 % 23.59\%。 在应用反馈条件下，相应数值上升到 9.27 % 9.27\%、16.59 % 16.59\%、27.16 % 27.16\% 和 31.57 % 31.57\%。 这一增加不应被解读为应用反馈会恶化语义修复的证据。 该脚手架将通过应用验证和构建验证的补丁数量从 602 602 提升到 928 928，从而使那些原本会被补丁应用失败所排除的补丁得以纳入。 新纳入的补丁可能包含较弱的语义修复，这提高了所观察到的语义缺陷的比例。

paragraphs.en: Adding Navigate-and-Locate yields a clear improvement relative to Apply-Feedback alone. The combined condition reduces the failure prevalence from 9.27 % 9.27\% to 4.36 % 4.36\% for Position, from 16.59 % 16.59\% to 5.64 % 5.64\% for Coverage, from 27.16 % 27.16\% to 11.49 % 11.49\% for Mechanism, and from 31.57 % 31.57\% to 18.30 % 18.30\% for Content. Mechanism shows the largest absolute reduction of 15.67 15.67 percentage points, corresponding to a 57.69 % 57.69\% relative reduction. Coverage exhibits the largest relative reduction, decreasing by 10.96 10.96 percentage points, or 66.02 % 66.02\% relative to its Apply-Feedback baseline. Equivalently, the Apply-Feedback prevalence is 2.36 2.36 times the combined-condition prevalence for Mechanism and 2.94 2.94 times that for Coverage. Position and Content decrease by 52.93 % 52.93\% and 42.05 % 42.05\% , respectively. These results suggest that repository exploration helps models identify and structurally address a more complete set of vulnerable paths, including other exploitable sites that share the same root cause, while also enabling them to select and correctly reuse the application’s existing authorization facilities. The lower Content prevalence further suggests improved reconstruction of the target authorization policy, although Content remains the most prevalent failure dimension under the combined condition.
paragraphs.zh: 相比仅使用 Apply-Feedback，加入 Navigate-and-Locate 带来了明显的改进。 组合条件将 Position 的失败率从 9.27 % 9.27\% 降至 4.36 % 4.36\%，将 Coverage 的失败率从 16.59 % 16.59\% 降至 5.64 % 5.64\%，将 Mechanism 的失败率从 27.16 % 27.16\% 降至 11.49 % 11.49\%，并将 Content 的失败率从 31.57 % 31.57\% 降至 18.30 % 18.30\%。 Mechanism 表现出最大的绝对降幅，为 15.67 15.67 个百分点，对应 57.69 % 57.69\% 的相对降幅。 Coverage 表现出最大的相对降幅，下降了 10.96 10.96 个百分点，即相对于其 Apply-Feedback 基线下降了 66.02 % 66.02\%。 等价地说，对于 Mechanism，Apply-Feedback 的失败率是组合条件失败率的 2.36 2.36 倍，对于 Coverage 则是 2.94 2.94 倍。 Position 和 Content 分别下降了 52.93 % 52.93\% 和 42.05 % 42.05\%。 这些结果表明，仓库探索有助于模型识别并在结构上修复更完整的易受攻击路径集合，包括共享同一根因的其他可利用位置，同时还能使其选择并正确复用应用程序现有的授权机制。 Content 失败率的进一步降低表明对目标授权策略的重建有所改进，尽管在组合条件下 Content 仍然是最普遍的失败维度。

paragraphs.en: The combined condition also narrows the gap between the Base LLMs and the closed-source agents. Claude Code reports failure prevalences of 3.01 % 3.01\% , 9.02 % 9.02\% , 8.27 % 8.27\% , and 14.29 % 14.29\% for Position, Coverage, Mechanism, and Content, respectively, while Codex reports 2.27 % 2.27\% , 3.03 % 3.03\% , 5.30 % 5.30\% , and 11.36 % 11.36\% . The combined Base LLM condition reaches 4.36 % 4.36\% , 5.64 % 5.64\% , 11.49 % 11.49\% , and 18.30 % 18.30\% for the same dimensions. In particular, GPT-5.5 under the combined condition has failure prevalences of 0.85 % 0.85\% for Position, 1.71 % 1.71\% for Coverage, 1.71 % 1.71\% for Mechanism, and 5.98 % 5.98\% for Content, closely approaching the Codex profile. Claude Opus 4.8 likewise approaches Claude Code in Content and Mechanism, with corresponding prevalences of 16.15 % 16.15\% and 5.38 % 5.38\% . These results indicate that the two lightweight scaffolds recover part of the repository-level interaction available to stronger LLM agents, although they do not eliminate the remaining difficulty of reconstructing complete BAC authorization semantics.

sents.en: Claude Code reports failure prevalences of 3.01 % 3.01\% , 9.02 % 9.02\% , 8.27 % 8.27\% , and 14.29 % 14.29\% for Position, Coverage, Mechanism, and Content, respectively, while Codex reports 2.27 % 2.27\% , 3.03 % 3.03\% , 5.30 % 5.30\% , and 11.36 % 11.36\% .
The combined Base LLM condition reaches 4.36 % 4.36\% , 5.64 % 5.64\% , 11.49 % 11.49\% , and 18.30 % 18.30\% for the same dimensions.

In particular, GPT-5.5 under the combined condition has failure prevalences of 0.85 % 0.85\% for Position, 1.71 % 1.71\% for Coverage, 1.71 % 1.71\% for Mechanism, and 5.98 % 5.98\% for Content, closely approaching the Codex profile.

sents.en: These results indicate that the two lightweight scaffolds recover part of the repository-level interaction available to stronger LLM agents, although they do not eliminate the remaining difficulty of reconstructing complete BAC authorization semantics.

paragraphs.en: Although the preceding analysis identifies the dominant failure dimensions of LLM-generated BAC patches, it does not establish that official patches are always semantically correct or uniformly superior. We therefore compare official and LLM-generated patches under the same dynamic validation protocol and using the BAC repair-strategy framework. Our audit identified defects in several official patches, as summarized in Table 10 . We next examine three representative cases, namely, CVE-2022-4505, CVE-2023-2946, and CVE-2023-31066, which illustrate distinct ways in which some LLM-generated patches outperform the corresponding official patches.

paragraphs.en: CVE-2022-4505. In OpenEMR’s CVE-2022-4505, a portal patient can gain unauthorized access to another patient’s appointment by modifying the request parameter eid . Figure 6 shows an excerpt from the official patch (commit 235b1910 ), released on August 20, 2022 ( OpenEMR Project, 2022 ) . The patch uses the patient identifier stored in $_SESSION[’pid’] to retrieve the patient’s appointments through the existing project facility fetchAppointments() , and then uses PHP’s built-in array_search() function to determine whether the requested appointment belongs to that set. This implements the intended owner-based authorization policy. However, the patch directly interprets the index returned by array_search() as a Boolean value. If a legitimate appointment is located at index 0 0 , the function returns 0 0 , which is interpreted as false and causes the request to be rejected. The official patch therefore blocks the reported unauthorized access but can also deny legitimate owner access. This implementation defect remained in the official repair for nearly two years before OpenEMR corrected it on August 8, 2024 by strictly comparing the return value with false , as illustrated by the follow-up patch (commit 210a63b4 ) in Figure 7 ( OpenEMR Project, 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: CVE-2022-4505。 在 OpenEMR 的 CVE-2022-4505 中，门户患者可以通过修改请求参数 eid 获取对另一位患者预约的未授权访问。 图 6 展示了官方补丁（提交 235b1910）的摘录，该补丁于 2022 年 8 月 20 日发布（OpenEMR Project, 2022）。 该补丁使用存储在 $_SESSION['pid'] 中的患者标识符，通过项目现有的 fetchAppointments() 功能检索该患者的预约，然后使用 PHP 内置的 array_search() 函数来判断所请求的预约是否属于该集合。 这实现了预期的基于所有者的授权策略。 然而，该补丁直接将 array_search() 返回的索引解释为布尔值。 如果合法的预约位于索引 0 0 处，该函数会返回 0 0，这会被解释为 false，从而导致请求被拒绝。 因此，官方补丁虽然阻止了所报告的未授权访问，但也可能拒绝合法所有者的访问。 这一实现缺陷在官方修复中存在了近两年，直到 2024 年 8 月 8 日 OpenEMR 通过将返回值与 false 进行严格比较才将其纠正，如图 7 中的后续补丁（提交 210a63b4）所示（OpenEMR Project, 2024）。

paragraphs.en: The BAC repair-strategy framework distinguishes the intended authorization policy from its implementation. The original official patch has an accurate Position, complete Coverage, and correct Content, but its Mechanism fails because it violates the return-value contract of array_search() . Some LLM-generated patches avoid this particular pitfall through alternative mechanisms. For example, the patch generated by Gemini 3.5 Flash in Figure 8 relies on neither fetchAppointments() nor array_search() . Instead, it issues a parameterized SQL query to retrieve the authoritative pc_pid of the appointment identified by eid and compares it directly with the authenticated patient identifier. It rejects nonexistent appointments and ownership mismatches before loading the appointment, thereby implementing the same owner-based policy without an index-valued intermediate result. The patch therefore constitutes a reliable project-native Mechanism and passes both dynamic tests. This case demonstrates that an LLM-generated patch can preserve the intended authorization semantics while avoiding a mechanism-level defect in the corresponding official repair.
paragraphs.zh: BAC 修复策略框架将预期的授权策略与其实现区分开来。 原始官方补丁的 Position 准确、Coverage 完整、Content 正确，但其 Mechanism 失败，因为它违反了 array_search() 的返回值约定。 一些 LLM 生成的补丁通过替代机制避开了这一特定陷阱。 例如，图 8 中由 Gemini 3.5 Flash 生成的补丁既不依赖 fetchAppointments() 也不依赖 array_search()。 相反，它发出一条参数化的 SQL 查询，以检索由 eid 标识的预约的权威 pc_pid，并将其直接与已认证的患者标识符进行比较。 它在加载预约之前拒绝不存在的预约和所有权不匹配的情况，从而在没有索引值中间结果的情况下实现了相同的基于所有者的策略。 因此，该补丁构成了一个可靠的项目原生 Mechanism，并通过了全部动态测试。 该案例表明，LLM 生成的补丁可以在避免相应官方修复中机制级缺陷的同时，保留预期的授权语义。

paragraphs.en: CVE-2023-2946. In OpenEMR’s CVE-2023-2946, the prescription module lacks an appropriate authorization gate, allowing any authenticated user, including low-privilege Front Office and Receptionist users, to view, create, or modify prescriptions for arbitrary patients. Figure 9 shows an excerpt from the official patch (commit 81832ac ), released on March 14, 2023 ( OpenEMR Project, 2023a ) . The patch attempts to enforce the prescription permission through OpenEMR’s phpGACL-based authorization mechanism by invoking the central AclMain::aclCheckCore() facility. In terms of authorization Content , it targets the intended prescription access-control object (ACO) in the patients section. However, the patch confuses the ACO’s name with its lookup value and invokes AclMain::aclCheckCore(’patients’, ’prescriptions’) . OpenEMR maintains its ACL configuration across multiple tables, including gacl_aco_map . In this table, prescriptions is the ACO’s name , whereas rx is its value . The configured section/value pair for the prescription ACO is therefore (’patients’, ’rx’) . The pair supplied by the official patch, (’patients’, ’prescriptions’) , does not identify this configured ACO. Because AclMain::aclCheckCore() resolves the ACO using its configured value , the call returns false for legitimate physicians. The official patch therefore blocks the reported unauthorized access but also denies legitimate prescription operations.
paragraphs.zh: CVE-2023-2946。 在 OpenEMR 的 CVE-2023-2946 中，处方模块缺少适当的授权门控，使得任何经过身份验证的用户，包括低权限的前台和接待员用户，都能查看、创建或修改任意患者的处方。 图 9 展示了 2023 年 3 月 14 日发布的官方补丁（提交 81832ac）的节选（OpenEMR Project, 2023a）。 该补丁试图通过调用中央 AclMain::aclCheckCore() 设施，借助 OpenEMR 基于 phpGACL 的授权机制来强制执行处方权限。 就授权内容而言，它针对的是 patients 部分中预期的处方访问控制对象（ACO）。 然而，该补丁将 ACO 的名称与其查找值混淆，调用了 AclMain::aclCheckCore('patients', 'prescriptions')。 OpenEMR 将其 ACL 配置保存在多个表中，其中包括 gacl_aco_map。 在该表中，prescriptions 是 ACO 的名称，而 rx 是其值。 因此，处方 ACO 的已配置 section/值对是 ('patients', 'rx')。 官方补丁提供的 ('patients', 'prescriptions') 并不能标识这个已配置的 ACO。 由于 AclMain::aclCheckCore() 是使用已配置的值来解析 ACO 的，因此该调用对合法的医生返回 false。 因此，官方补丁在阻止所报告的未授权访问的同时，也拒绝了合法的处方操作。

sents.en: In OpenEMR’s CVE-2023-2946, the prescription module lacks an appropriate authorization gate, allowing any authenticated user, including low-privilege Front Office and Receptionist users, to view, create, or modify prescriptions for arbitrary patients.
sents.zh: 在 OpenEMR 的 CVE-2023-2946 中，处方模块缺少适当的授权门控，使得任何经过身份验证的用户，包括低权限的前台和接待员用户，都能查看、创建或修改任意患者的处方。

sents.en: Figure 9 shows an excerpt from the official patch (commit 81832ac ), released on March 14, 2023 ( OpenEMR Project, 2023a ) .
sents.zh: 图 9 展示了 2023 年 3 月 14 日发布的官方补丁（提交 81832ac）的节选（OpenEMR Project, 2023a）。

sents.en: The patch attempts to enforce the prescription permission through OpenEMR’s phpGACL-based authorization mechanism by invoking the central AclMain::aclCheckCore() facility.
sents.zh: 该补丁试图通过调用中央 AclMain::aclCheckCore() 设施，借助 OpenEMR 基于 phpGACL 的授权机制来强制执行处方权限。

sents.en: In terms of authorization Content , it targets the intended prescription access-control object (ACO) in the patients section.
sents.zh: 就授权内容而言，它针对的是 patients 部分中预期的处方访问控制对象（ACO）。

sents.en: However, the patch confuses the ACO’s name with its lookup value and invokes AclMain::aclCheckCore(’patients’, ’prescriptions’) .
sents.zh: 然而，该补丁将 ACO 的名称与其查找值混淆，调用了 AclMain::aclCheckCore('patients', 'prescriptions')。

sents.en: OpenEMR maintains its ACL configuration across multiple tables, including gacl_aco_map .
sents.zh: OpenEMR 将其 ACL 配置保存在多个表中，其中包括 gacl_aco_map。

sents.en: In this table, prescriptions is the ACO’s name , whereas rx is its value .
sents.zh: 在该表中，prescriptions 是 ACO 的名称，而 rx 是其值。

sents.en: The configured section/value pair for the prescription ACO is therefore (’patients’, ’rx’) .
sents.zh: 因此，处方 ACO 的已配置 section/值对是 ('patients', 'rx')。

sents.en: The pair supplied by the official patch, (’patients’, ’prescriptions’) , does not identify this configured ACO.
sents.zh: 官方补丁提供的 ('patients', 'prescriptions') 并不能标识这个已配置的 ACO。

sents.en: Because AclMain::aclCheckCore() resolves the ACO using its configured value , the call returns false for legitimate physicians.
sents.zh: 由于 AclMain::aclCheckCore() 是使用已配置的值来解析 ACO 的，因此该调用对合法的医生返回 false。

sents.en: The official patch therefore blocks the reported unauthorized access but also denies legitimate prescription operations.
sents.zh: 因此，官方补丁在阻止所报告的未授权访问的同时，也拒绝了合法的处方操作。

paragraphs.en: An OpenEMR community user reported this regression on May 11, 2023, under the title “Physician Can’t Fill Up Prescriptions” ( OpenEMR Community, 2023 ) . OpenEMR released a corrective patch the following day by replacing prescriptions with rx , as illustrated by the follow-up patch (commit a8ed9cd ) in Figure 10 ( OpenEMR Project, 2023b ) . Under the BAC repair-strategy framework, the official patch targets the intended authorization Content and places the check at a relevant Position, but its Mechanism fails because it violates the identifier contract of the existing phpGACL facility. Several effective LLM-generated patches avoid this error by invoking AclMain::aclCheckCore() with the correct (’patients’, ’rx’) section/value pair. For example, the Kimi K2.7-Code-generated patch excerpted in Figure 11 inserts a concise guard before loading the prescription controller and uses the correct ACO value ,which passes both dynamic tests. This case demonstrates that some LLM-generated patches can correctly reuse a project’s standard authorization mechanism while avoiding an identifier-contract error in the corresponding official repair.
paragraphs.zh: 一位 OpenEMR 社区用户于 2023 年 5 月 11 日以“医生无法填写处方”为标题报告了此回归问题（OpenEMR Community, 2023）。 OpenEMR 在次日发布了修正补丁，将 prescriptions 替换为 rx，如图 10 中的后续补丁（commit a8ed9cd）所示（OpenEMR Project, 2023b）。 在 BAC 修复策略框架下，官方补丁针对的是预期的授权 Content，并将检查放置在相关的 Position，但其 Mechanism 失效，因为它违反了现有 phpGACL 设施的标识符契约。 多个有效的 LLM 生成补丁通过以正确的（'patients', 'rx'）section/value 对调用 AclMain::aclCheckCore() 来避免此错误。 例如，图 11 中摘录的 Kimi K2.7-Code 生成的补丁在加载处方控制器之前插入了一个简洁的守卫，并使用了正确的 ACO 值，从而通过了全部动态测试。 此案例表明，一些 LLM 生成补丁能够正确复用项目的标准授权机制，同时避免相应官方修复中的标识符契约错误。

paragraphs.en: CVE-2023-31066. Apache InLong’s CVE-2023-31066 is an object-level broken access-control vulnerability in StreamSource management. A user can tamper with the source identifier in a deletion request and illegally delete a StreamSource belonging to another user. The same missing group-level authorization check affects the corresponding stop and start/restart paths. In the vulnerable service implementation, these methods resolve the target source from a caller-controlled identifier and perform the state-changing operation without verifying whether the caller is authorized to operate on the source’s owning InLong group. The intended policy permits the group’s designated inCharges users and administrators to perform these operations. To address this vulnerability, the official patch (commit 231dbd5a ), released on April 4, 2023 ( Apache InLong Project, 2023 ) adds group-level authorization checks to the three affected service paths and is effective.
paragraphs.zh: CVE-2023-31066。 Apache InLong 的 CVE-2023-31066 是 StreamSource 管理中一个对象级访问控制失效漏洞。 用户可以篡改删除请求中的 source 标识符，非法删除属于其他用户的 StreamSource。 同样缺失的组级授权检查也影响对应的停止和启动/重启路径。 在存在漏洞的服务实现中，这些方法根据调用者可控的标识符解析目标 source，并在未验证调用者是否被授权操作该 source 所属 InLong 组的情况下执行改变状态的操作。 预期的策略允许该组的指定 inCharges 用户和管理员执行这些操作。 为修复该漏洞，官方补丁（commit 231dbd5a）于 2023 年 4 月 4 日发布（Apache InLong Project, 2023），为三条受影响的服务路径添加了组级授权检查，并且是有效的。

paragraphs.en: Applying the Coverage dimension of the BAC repair-strategy framework to the LLM-generated patches revealed that many of them also protected the sibling forceDelete path, as illustrated by the effective patch generated by DeepSeek-V4 Pro in Figure 12 . Both delete and forceDelete perform deletion-related state changes on StreamSource records, but delete accepts a source identifier and targets one source, whereas forceDelete accepts a groupId / streamId pair and affects all sources associated with the specified group and stream. A manual source audit followed by an extended PoC confirmed that forceDelete lacked the same group-level authorization check as the delete path. A separate exploit against the latest available InLong release at the time of our study, version 1.6.0, further confirmed that the path remained vulnerable. We reported the finding to the Apache Software Foundation and the InLong maintainers. The finding was subsequently assigned a new CVE, and the maintainers released a patch (commit e92cb3c ) for forceDelete on June 22, 2026, as illustrated in Figure 13 ( Apache InLong Project, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 将 BAC 修复策略框架的覆盖（Coverage）维度应用于 LLM 生成的补丁后发现，其中许多补丁还保护了 forceDelete 这个同源路径，如图 12 中 DeepSeek-V4 Pro 生成的有效补丁所示。 delete 和 forceDelete 都会对 StreamSource 记录执行与删除相关的状态变更，但 delete 接受一个源标识符并只针对单个源，而 forceDelete 接受一个 groupId / streamId 对，会影响与指定组和流关联的所有源。 人工源代码审计加上后续扩展的概念验证（PoC）确认，forceDelete 缺少与 delete 路径相同的组级授权检查。 针对我们研究时最新可用版本 InLong 1.6.0 的另一次利用进一步证实，该路径仍然存在漏洞。 我们已将该发现报告给 Apache 软件基金会和 InLong 的维护者。 该发现随后被分配了一个新的 CVE，维护者于 2026 年 6 月 22 日发布了针对 forceDelete 的补丁（commit e92cb3c），如图 13 所示（Apache InLong Project, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: In effect, while repairing a BAC vulnerability disclosed in 2023, some LLM-generated patches incidentally protected a previously unknown sibling path with the same root cause, without any explicit instruction to inspect that path. The BAC vulnerability in forceDelete had remained undiscovered for more than three years across multiple InLong releases, despite the earlier identification and remediation of closely related vulnerable paths. This case shows that some LLMs can explore vulnerable code regions and related execution paths with sufficient depth and breadth to uncover less conspicuous vulnerable paths that may escape maintainers’ attention, thereby exhibiting strong performance in the Coverage dimension and achieving broader vulnerability coverage than the original official repair in some cases.
paragraphs.zh: 实际上，在修复 2023 年披露的一个 BAC（越权访问）漏洞时，某些 LLM 生成的补丁在没有任何明确指示的情况下，顺带保护了一条此前未知的、具有相同根因的同源路径。 forceDelete 中的 BAC 漏洞尽管与此前已被识别并修复的密切相关漏洞路径同源，却在多个 InLong 版本中未被发现的时长超过三年。 该案例表明，某些 LLM 能够以足够的深度和广度探索易受攻击的代码区域及相关执行路径，从而发现那些可能被维护者忽视的不太显眼的漏洞路径，因此在覆盖率（Coverage）维度上表现出色，在某些情况下实现了比原始官方修复更广的漏洞覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: For the other three official patches with defects, the official patch for CVE-2022-4684 places the repair at an inaccurate Position and therefore performs only a superficial repair that fails to block the PoC exploit. The official patch for CVE-2022-4802 has two independent defects. First, it invokes a security-helper function that is itself buggy in the target source version, causing the patch to fail the functional test. Second, its Coverage is incomplete, leaving part of the vulnerable behavior unprotected and causing the PoC test to fail. The official patch for CVE-2022-4803 likewise has incomplete Coverage and therefore fails to block the PoC exploit. In contrast, for each of these vulnerabilities, there are effective LLM-generated patches that passed both the PoC and functional tests.

paragraphs.en: Given the remarkable ability of agentic systems to solve complex security tasks ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Ullah et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , our work, focusing on the base LLMs, is driven by following reason. Specifically, as the LLM agents become more capable, their architectures also become too complex to be explored and analyzed. It remains unclear how large the performance gap between base LLMs and LLM agents is on a specific downstream task, which agent components contribute most to this gap, and which limitations of the underlying models these components alleviate. Our evaluation of eight base LLMs and two widely used commercial LLM agents on BAC-Bench helps demystify the role of agentic support. With just two lightweight scaffolds, Apply-Feedback and Navigate-and-Locate , Opus 4.8 improves its repair rate from 30.43% in the single-turn setting to 75.36%, only 3.63 percentage points below the 78.99% achieved by Claude Code using the same underlying model. Across all eight base LLMs, these scaffolds increase the average repair rate from 37.68% in the single-turn setting to 66.03%. These results indicate that the key to BAC repair lies in mitigating the model’s hallucination of diff metadata during patch generation and granting the model repository-level access to the codebase so that it can locate the vulnerability, confirm the root cause, and construct the repair. Together, these two forms of support enable base LLMs to approach the repair capabilities of LLM agents. Our experimental setup thus enables this finding, providing empirical guidance and insight for designing minimal BAC vulnerability repair harnesses with improved effectiveness and efficiency in future work.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于智能体系统在解决复杂安全任务方面的卓越能力（Wang et al., 2026; Ji et al., 2026; Li et al., 2026; Ullah et al., 2026; Zhang et al., 2026b），我们这项聚焦于基础大语言模型的工作出于以下原因。 具体而言，随着大语言模型智能体的能力越来越强，其架构也变得过于复杂，难以探索和分析。 目前仍不清楚的是：在特定下游任务上，基础大语言模型与大语言模型智能体之间的性能差距有多大，哪些智能体组件对这一差距贡献最大，以及这些组件缓解了底层模型的哪些局限。 我们在 BAC-Bench 上对八个基础大语言模型和两个广泛使用的商用大语言模型智能体进行了评估，有助于揭开智能体支持的神秘面纱。 仅借助两个轻量级脚手架 Apply-Feedback 和 Navigate-and-Locate，Opus 4.8 将其修复率从单轮设定下的 30.43% 提升至 75.36%，仅比使用相同底层模型的 Claude Code 所取得的 78.99% 低 3.63 个百分点。 在所有八个基础大语言模型上，这些脚手架将平均修复率从单轮设定下的 37.68% 提升至 66.03%。 这些结果表明，BAC 修复的关键在于减轻模型在补丁生成过程中对 diff 元数据的幻觉，并赋予模型对代码库的仓库级访问权限，使其能够定位漏洞、确认根本原因并构建修复。 这两种支持形式共同使基础大语言模型能够逼近大语言模型智能体的修复能力。 因此，我们的实验设定促成了这一发现，为未来工作中设计更高效、更有效的最小化 BAC 漏洞修复工具提供了实证指导和洞见。

paragraphs.en: Although our BAC repair-strategy framework helps pinpoint the dimensions along which a patch fails, it has not fully solved everything. Basically, compared with the relatively standardized repair patterns for memory-safety vulnerabilities, BAC admits a wider range of repair strategies. For a BAC vulnerability caused by a missing access-control check, viable repairs may range from adding a filtering predicate to an SQL query at the data layer, through implementing a dedicated authorization function from scratch at the business layer, to reusing an existing authorization helper at the control layer. This diversity raises the question of what constitutes a better BAC patch, which motivated us to develop a four-dimensional framework for identifying desirable solutions within the broad BAC repair space. Choosing among these strategies is non-trivial because repair placement can affect both the vulnerability units and the attack paths covered. A single BAC may manifest as several vulnerability units sharing the same root cause, and each reachable through multiple attack paths. For example, an access-control check placed in operation-specific business logic at the business layer can fix only one unit yet block every attack path reaching it, whereas a repair at an endpoint at the presentation layer may protect several units, but only along paths through that endpoint (such as Usememos’s CVE-2022-4684). These differences in repair location and protection scope are captured by the framework’s Position and Coverage dimensions, while Mechanism and Content assess the security facilities used and the correctness of the implemented authorization policy, respectively. An Ideal patch therefore requires a carefully chosen repair location that provides robust protection with minimal code changes, reuses existing security facilities wherever possible.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我们的 BAC 修复策略框架有助于定位补丁在哪些维度上失效，但它并未完全解决所有问题。 基本上，与相对标准化的内存安全漏洞修复模式相比，BAC 允许的修复策略范围更广。 对于由缺失访问控制检查导致的 BAC 漏洞，可行的修复方案包括：在数据层为 SQL 查询添加过滤谓词，在业务层从零开始实现专门的授权函数，或者在控制层复用现有的授权辅助函数。 这种多样性引发了一个问题：什么才是更好的 BAC 补丁，这促使我们开发了一个四维框架，用于在广阔的 BAC 修复空间中识别理想的解决方案。 在这些策略之间进行选择并非易事，因为修复位置的选择会影响所覆盖的漏洞单元和攻击路径。 单个 BAC 可能表现为共享同一根因的多个漏洞单元，且每个漏洞单元都可通过多条攻击路径到达。 例如，位于业务层特定操作业务逻辑中的访问控制检查可能只能修复一个漏洞单元，却能阻断到达该单元的所有攻击路径；而位于表示层端点处的修复可能保护多个漏洞单元，但仅限于经过该端点的路径（例如 Usememos 的 CVE-2022-4684）。 修复位置和保护范围的这些差异由框架的 Position（位置）和 Coverage（覆盖）维度刻画，而 Mechanism（机制）和 Content（内容）维度则分别评估所使用的安全设施和所实现授权策略的正确性。 因此，一个理想的补丁需要精心选择修复位置，以最小的代码改动提供鲁棒的保护，并尽可能复用现有的安全设施。

paragraphs.en: In our large-scale analysis of LLM-generated patches, we adopted a coarse-grained assessment scheme that assigns binary correctness labels along each dimension of the framework. On the one hand, our results indeed reveal a valuable finding: failures along the Content dimension remain the most common, suggesting that the hardest part of BAC repair is reconstructing the intended authorization policy expressed in the application’s business logic. This finding guides our future work on BAC repair. Specifically, we plan to investigate policy-inference techniques that recover the intended access-control policy of the vulnerable scenario from source code, which is often the only material available in a web application for this purpose, by drawing on evidence such as sibling endpoints, data models, and project conventions, so that generated checks implement the intended policy more faithfully. On the other hand, we still regard binary correctness labeling as only one practical way to apply the BAC repair-strategy framework to large numbers of patches, reflecting a trade-off between analytical detail and evaluation feasibility. As a methodology for characterizing and analyzing BAC patches, the framework can provide richer guidance and support deeper analysis when applied to a specific patch in a concrete web application without such simplification. We therefore plan to further investigate and refine the framework to better analyze BAC patches, evaluate BAC repair tools more objectively and comprehensively, and guide improvements to these tools in the future.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们对LLM生成补丁的大规模分析中，我们采用了一种粗粒度的评估方案，为框架的每个维度分配二元正确性标签。 一方面，我们的结果确实揭示了一个有价值的发现：内容维度的失败仍然最为常见，这表明BAC修复中最困难的部分是重建应用程序业务逻辑所表达的预期授权策略。 这一发现为我们未来在BAC修复方面的工作提供了指引。 具体而言，我们计划研究策略推断技术，从源代码中恢复易受攻击场景的预期访问控制策略（源代码通常是web应用中实现此目的的唯一可用材料），通过利用同兄弟端点、数据模型和项目约定等证据，使生成的检查更忠实地实现预期策略。 另一方面，我们仍然将二元正确性标注视为将BAC修复策略框架应用于大量补丁的一种实用方式，这体现了分析细节与评估可行性之间的权衡。 作为一种刻画和分析BAC补丁的方法论，该框架在具体web应用中应用于特定补丁时，如果不受此类简化限制，可以提供更丰富的指导并支持更深入的分析。 因此，我们计划进一步研究和完善该框架，以便更好地分析BAC补丁，更客观、更全面地评估BAC修复工具，并在未来指导这些工具的改进。

paragraphs.en: External Threats mainly lie in the scope of the benchmark and the studied systems. BAC-Bench covers 46 BAC vulnerabilities from six applications in four languages, so our findings may not generalize to BAC vulnerabilities in web applications built with other programming languages or access-control architectures. To mitigate this threat, the studied applications span RBAC, ACL, and hybrid access-control models, and the vulnerabilities cover Broken Function-Level Authorization (BFLA) and Broken Object-Level Authorization (BOLA), horizontal and vertical violations, and read- and write-based unauthorized operations. To mitigate the second threat, we conducted a systematic survey of state-of-the-art LLMs and selected the most advanced and representative models at the time of our experiments, spanning both closed-source and open-weight models and including the strongest LLM agents.
paragraphs.zh: 外部有效性威胁主要存在于基准测试和所研究系统的范围内。 BAC-Bench 涵盖了四种语言六个应用中的 46 个 BAC 漏洞，因此我们的发现可能无法推广到使用其他编程语言或访问控制架构构建的 Web 应用中的 BAC 漏洞。 为缓解这一威胁，所研究的应用涵盖了 RBAC、ACL 和混合访问控制模型，且所涵盖的漏洞包括功能级授权失效（BFLA）和对象级授权失效（BOLA）、横向与纵向越权，以及基于读和写的未授权操作。 为缓解第二个威胁，我们对最先进的大语言模型进行了系统性调研，并选取了实验开展时最先进且最具代表性的模型，涵盖闭源和开放权重模型，并包括最强大语言模型智能体。

paragraphs.en: Internal Threats mainly concern the fairness of the comparison across the evaluated systems and the reliability of the labeling procedure. All systems are evaluated in the same isolated sandbox, with identical inputs and the same validation pipeline, and the combined-scaffold condition further places the base LLMs on exactly the same input as the agents, so that the reported performance differences reflect the systems’ capabilities rather than unequal experimental conditions. Our scaffolds are model-agnostic by design, and the full replication package, including all prompts, configurations, and experimental scripts, is publicly released ( Liu, 2026 ) . To account for the non-deterministic nature of LLMs, we explicitly document the configuration settings of every evaluated system and repeat each (system, vulnerability) pair three times, reporting all runs and their spread. In addition, most vulnerabilities in BAC-Bench were disclosed around 2022 and may thus appear in the models’ pre-training corpora, but the sampled LLM-generated patches differ substantially from the official fixes with almost no exact matches, and one patch even repaired a zero-day vulnerability CVE-2026-63040 ( Apache Software Foundation, 2026 ) , that no model could have known in advance, suggesting that the measured effectiveness is not reducible to memorization. Finally, the four-dimensional labels are assigned by an LLM-assisted audit, and a blinded audit of a stratified random sample of 108 patches found the labels to agree with the human consensus at 96.3% ( κ = 0.926 \kappa=0.926 ), supporting the reliability of the labels used in our analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 内部威胁主要涉及被评估系统之间比较的公平性以及标注过程的可靠性。 所有系统都在同一个隔离沙箱中评估，使用相同的输入和相同的验证流水线，并且组合脚手架条件还进一步让基础 LLM 获得与智能体完全相同的输入，从而确保所报告的性能差异反映的是系统的能力，而非不平等的实验条件。 我们的脚手架在设计上是与模型无关的，并且完整的复现包，包括所有提示词、配置和实验脚本，均已公开发布（Liu, 2026）。 为了考虑 LLM 的非确定性本质，我们明确记录了每个被评估系统的配置设置，并对每个（系统，漏洞）对重复实验三次，报告所有运行结果及其波动范围。 此外，BAC-Bench 中的大多数漏洞是在 2022 年左右披露的，因此可能出现在模型的预训练语料库中，但采样的 LLM 生成补丁与官方修复方案差异巨大，几乎没有完全匹配的情况，其中一个补丁甚至修复了零日漏洞 CVE-2026-63040（Apache Software Foundation, 2026），这是任何模型都不可能提前知道的，这表明所测量的有效性不能归约为记忆效应。 最后，四维标签由 LLM 辅助的审计来分配，对 108 个补丁的分层随机样本进行的盲审计发现，标签与人类共识的一致率达到 96.3%（κ = 0.926 \kappa=0.926），支持了我们分析中所用标签的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Construct Threats primarily stem from the operationalization of repair effectiveness. The first threat concerns the test instruments. A patch that blocks the attack may still break legitimate functionality, so the PoC exploit alone cannot establish the effectiveness of a patch. The built-in test suites of web applications may not fill this gap, as they are largely oriented toward general functionality and rarely touch the specific endpoints, operations, and roles involved in a given vulnerability. To mitigate this threat, we develop a functional test program for each vulnerability, and we run the project’s own test suite whenever available to complement its limited breadth. Together, the PoC validation program and the functional test program instantiate closure and preservation in Definition 2.2 . The second threat concerns the decision mechanism of the oracles, which may misjudge a violation. To mitigate this threat, we use a unique-marker content match for unauthorized reads and database-state inspection complemented by an application-level re-read for unauthorized writes, rather than response-based oracles, which are brittle for reads and misjudge writes at a high rate. The third threat concerns the implementation of the oracle programs, which are drafted by the LLM. To ensure their correctness and fidelity to the oracle design (§4.2), every program is manually reviewed and validated through actual execution in the runtime sandbox, confirming that each PoC program triggers the disclosed vulnerability on the unpatched application and that each functional test passes on it.
paragraphs.zh: 构造效度威胁主要源于修复效果的可操作化。 第一个威胁涉及测试工具。 一个阻断攻击的补丁仍可能破坏合法功能，因此仅凭 PoC 漏洞利用程序无法确立补丁的有效性。 Web 应用自带的测试套件可能无法填补这一空白，因为它们主要面向一般功能，很少触及给定漏洞所涉及的具体端点、操作和角色。 为缓解这一威胁，我们为每个漏洞开发了一个功能测试程序，并在项目自身测试套件可用时运行它，以弥补其覆盖面的不足。 PoC 验证程序与功能测试程序共同实例化了定义 2.2 中的封闭性与保持性。 第二个威胁涉及判定器的决策机制，它可能对违规行为做出误判。 为缓解这一威胁，对于未授权读取，我们使用唯一标记的内容匹配；对于未授权写入，我们使用数据库状态检查并辅以应用层的重新读取，而不是基于响应的判定器——后者对读取场景很脆弱，且对写入场景的误判率很高。 第三个威胁涉及判定器程序的实现，这些程序由大语言模型起草。 为确保其正确性以及对判定器设计（§4.2）的忠实性，每个程序都经过人工审查，并在运行时沙箱中通过实际执行加以验证，确认每个 PoC 程序都能在未打补丁的应用上触发所披露的漏洞，且每个功能测试都能在该应用上通过。

paragraphs.en: The central task of the detection of BAC is to identify missing or inconsistent authorization checks, and existing approaches fall broadly into white-box and black-box paradigms. White-box approaches analyze the application’s source code toward this end. Because web applications seldom ship an explicit access-control specification, AutoISES infers security specifications from code automatically and flags their violations ( Tan et al., 2008 ) , and Sun et al. infer the intended per-role accesses from the program itself, treating any successful forced browsing as a likely vulnerability ( Sun et al., 2011 ) . RoleCast locates missing security checks even when the form of the checks is unknown ( Son et al., 2011 ) , and MACE extracts authorization context from database operations and verifies that it is enforced consistently, catching both horizontal and vertical privilege escalation ( Monshizadeh et al., 2014 ) . BolaRay proposes four authorization models common to database-backed applications and detects object-level violations against them ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . The same missing-check problem has also been studied beyond traditional web applications, in the Linux kernel through precise permission-check analysis ( Zhang et al., 2019 ) , in distributed cloud systems ( Lu et al., 2022 ) , in Kubernetes applications where excessive RBAC permissions are detected ( Gu et al., 2025 ) , and in modern Java web applications through accurate permission-check identification ( Shi et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: BAC检测的核心任务是识别缺失或不一致的授权检查，现有方法大致可分为白盒与黑盒两类范式。 白盒方法为此分析应用程序的源代码。 由于Web应用很少附带显式的访问控制规范，AutoISES自动从代码中推断安全规范并标记其违例（Tan et al., 2008），Sun等人则从程序本身推断各角色应有的访问，将任何成功的强制浏览都视为可能的漏洞（Sun et al., 2011）。 RoleCast即使在校查形式未知的情况下也能定位缺失的安全检查（Son et al., 2011），MACE从数据库操作中提取授权上下文并验证其被一致地执行，能够同时捕获水平与垂直权限提升（Monshizadeh et al., 2014）。 BolaRay提出了四种基于数据库的应用所共有的授权模型，并据此检测对象级别的违例（Huang et al., 2024）。 同样的缺失检查问题也在传统Web应用之外的领域得到研究，包括通过精确的权限检查分析研究Linux内核（Zhang et al., 2019）、分布式云系统（Lu et al., 2022）、检测过量RBAC权限的Kubernetes应用（Gu et al., 2025），以及通过准确的权限检查识别研究现代Java Web应用（Shi et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Black-box approaches drop the source-code requirement and instead decide whether a violation has occurred from externally observable behavior. AuthScope discovers vulnerable authorizations in online services through differential response analysis ( Zuo et al., 2017 ) . Observing that response-similarity oracles can catch only unauthorized reads, BACScan introduces a feedback-driven oracle that infers cross-operation dependencies and detects unauthorized reads and writes alike ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . BACFuzz further observes SQL-layer behavior during fuzzing to expose the otherwise silent violations ( Dharmaadi et al., 2025 ) . In sum, BAC detection is relatively mature in both paradigms, whereas the automated repair of BAC vulnerabilities has received far less attention.
paragraphs.zh: 黑盒方法摒弃了对源代码的要求，转而根据外部可观察到的行为来判断是否发生了违规。 AuthScope 通过差分响应分析发现在线服务中存在漏洞的授权（Zuo 等，2017）。 鉴于响应相似性判定器只能捕获未授权读取，BACScan 引入了一种反馈驱动的判定器，该判定器能够推断跨操作依赖关系，并同样能检测未授权读取和写入（Liu 等，2025）。 BACFuzz 进一步在模糊测试过程中观察 SQL 层的行为，以暴露原本不可见的违规（Dharmaadi 等，2025）。 总而言之，BAC 检测在这两种范式中都相对成熟，而 BAC 漏洞的自动化修复却受到的关注要少得多。

paragraphs.en: Work that directly automates BAC repair remains scarce and concentrated in the template-based paradigm. FixMeUp, the earliest such effort, mines an access-control template from PHP applications and inserts it where a check is missing ( Son et al., 2013 ) . The repair guarantees that the patched code implements the same access-control policy as the template, but not that the resulting program is correct, and the authors observe that web applications provide no standard framework for access control and that each application implements its policies in its own way. LogicPatcher, developed by the same research group as a repair follow-up to the MACE detector, extends detection to repair and uses path profiling to place patch code at a precise location, addressing parameter-tampering and authorization logic vulnerabilities ( Monshizadeh et al., 2016 ) . DRacv models RBAC web applications with a fine-grained navigation graph and mounts each patch as a standalone guard file that behaves like a firewall ahead of the vulnerable page rather than modifying the vulnerable code ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Beyond web applications, ACFix mines common RBAC practices from smart contracts and uses them to guide LLMs toward context-aware repair of access-control vulnerabilities ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 直接自动化 BAC 修复的工作仍然稀少，且集中于基于模板的范式。 FixMeUp 是此类工作中最早的一项，它从 PHP 应用中挖掘访问控制模板，并将其插入到缺失检查的位置（Son et al., 2013）。 该修复保证补丁后的代码实现了与模板相同的访问控制策略，但并不保证所得到的程序是正确的，而且作者观察到 Web 应用没有为访问控制提供标准框架，每个应用都以自己的方式实现其策略。 LogicPatcher 由与 MACE 检测器同一研究团队开发，作为 MACE 的修复后续工作，将检测扩展到修复，并使用路径剖析将补丁代码放置在精确位置，以应对参数篡改和授权逻辑漏洞（Monshizadeh et al., 2016）。 DRacv 用细粒度导航图对 RBAC Web 应用进行建模，并将每个补丁实现为一个独立的守卫文件，其行为就像部署在易受攻击页面之前的一道防火墙，而不是修改易受攻击的代码（Xu et al., 2025）。 超越 Web 应用之外，ACFix 从智能合约中挖掘常见的 RBAC 实践，并用它们引导大语言模型进行上下文感知的访问控制漏洞修复（Zhang et al., 2025）。

sents.zh: DRacv 用细粒度导航图对 RBAC Web 应用进行建模，并将每个补丁实现为一个独立的守卫文件，其行为就像部署在易受攻击页面之前的一道防火墙，而不是修改易受攻击的代码（Xu et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Beyond web applications, ACFix mines common RBAC practices from smart contracts and uses them to guide LLMs toward context-aware repair of access-control vulnerabilities ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 超越 Web 应用之外，ACFix 从智能合约中挖掘常见的 RBAC 实践，并用它们引导大语言模型进行上下文感知的访问控制漏洞修复（Zhang et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: These works share two limitations. First, the repair pattern is single. Nearly all of them reduce repair to inserting a missing check, which hardly covers object-level violations, property-level violations, or other more complex forms. Second, their applicability and scale are limited. All three systems are designed for traditional web application architectures, leaving their effectiveness on contemporary web applications unclear. ACFix targets smart contracts, where access control follows standardized idioms such as msg.sender , the onlyOwner modifier, and OpenZeppelin-style RBAC. Web applications offer no such regularity, so the paradigm of mining uniform practices and reapplying them does not transfer directly. In summary, as a logic vulnerability whose intended policy is rarely documented and whose realization varies across applications, BAC is inherently difficult to repair, which may explain why automated BAC repair has received only limited attention despite its prevalence.
paragraphs.zh: 这些工作存在两个共同局限。 首先，修复模式单一。 它们几乎都将修复简化为插入缺失的检查，很难覆盖对象级违规、属性级违规或其他更复杂的形式。 其次，它们的适用性和规模有限。 这三个系统都是为传统 Web 应用架构设计的，其在当代 Web 应用上的有效性尚不明确。 ACFix 面向智能合约，其中访问控制遵循标准化的惯用法，例如 msg.sender、onlyOwner 修饰符以及 OpenZeppelin 风格的 RBAC。 Web 应用不具备这种规律性，因此挖掘统一实践并加以复用的范式无法直接迁移。 总之，作为一种预期策略鲜有文档记录、且具体实现因应用而异的逻辑漏洞，BAC 天生难以修复，这或许可以解释为何尽管 BAC 十分普遍，自动化 BAC 修复却只受到有限关注。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based automated program repair has advanced rapidly, evolving from neural machine translation models to conversational LLMs and, most recently, to repository-level repair agents. The first generation translates defective functions into fixed ones end to end, exemplified by SequenceR ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and CURE ( Jiang et al., 2021 ) for general bugs and by VRepair ( Chen et al., 2023 ) and VulRepair ( Fu et al., 2022 ) for security vulnerabilities, the latter two marking the vulnerable lines explicitly. The LLM generation shifts to zero-shot and conversational repair. AlphaRepair performs cloze-style infilling at the defective location ( Xia et al., 2023 ) , Pearce et al. systematically examine the zero-shot repair of security vulnerabilities ( Pearce et al., 2023 ) , and ChatRepair iterates patches through multi-turn dialogue ( Xia and Zhang, 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型的自动程序修复发展迅速，从神经机器翻译模型演进到对话式大语言模型，最近又发展到仓库级修复智能体。 第一代方法将缺陷函数端到端地翻译为修复后的函数，针对一般缺陷的典型代表有 SequenceR（Chen et al., 2021）和 CURE（Jiang et al., 2021），针对安全漏洞的典型代表有 VRepair（Chen et al., 2023）和 VulRepair（Fu et al., 2022），后两者显式标注了存在漏洞的代码行。 大语言模型时代则转向零样本修复与对话式修复。 AlphaRepair 在缺陷位置执行填空式的文本补全（Xia et al., 2023），Pearce 等人系统性地研究了安全漏洞的零样本修复（Pearce et al., 2023），而 ChatRepair 则通过多轮对话迭代生成补丁（Xia and Zhang, 2024）。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench then raised the task to the repository level, asking a model to edit a codebase so that a described issue is resolved ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , and spawned a generation of repair agents. SWE-agent introduces an agent-computer interface that lets the model navigate entire repositories and execute tests ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . AutoCodeRover combines structured code search over the program’s abstract syntax with spectrum-based fault localization ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Agentless takes the opposite direction and shows that a fixed three-phase pipeline of localization, repair, and patch validation remains competitive ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . Security-oriented agents have followed. PatchAgent integrates fault localization, patch generation, and validation into one autonomous agent that mimics human expertise, repairing over 90% of 178 real-world vulnerabilities ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . APPATCH couples semantics-aware code pruning with adaptive prompting and repairs vulnerabilities, including zero-days, without requiring a triggering input, although it assumes that the vulnerability location is known ( Nong et al., 2025 ) . The finalist teams in DARPA’s AI Cyber Challenge developed more comprehensive end-to-end systems that automatically discover and repair vulnerabilities in real-world software ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Chin et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench 随后将任务提升到仓库级别，要求模型编辑代码库以解决所描述的问题（Jimenez 等，2024），并催生了一代修复智能体。 SWE-agent 引入了智能体-计算机接口，使模型能够浏览整个仓库并执行测试（Yang 等，2024）。 AutoCodeRover 将基于程序抽象语法树的结构化代码搜索与基于频谱的故障定位相结合（Zhang 等，2024）。 Agentless 则走向相反方向，表明由定位、修复和补丁验证组成的固定三阶段流水线依然具有竞争力（Xia 等，2025）。 面向安全的智能体也随之出现。 PatchAgent 将故障定位、补丁生成和验证整合到一个模仿人类专家能力的自主智能体中，在 178 个真实漏洞中修复了超过 90%（Yu 等，2025）。 APPATCH 将语义感知的代码剪枝与自适应提示相结合，能够修复漏洞（包括零日漏洞）而无需触发输入，但它假设漏洞位置已知（Nong 等，2025）。 DARPA AI 网络挑战赛的决赛队伍开发了更全面的端到端系统，能够自动发现并修复真实软件中的漏洞（Zhang 等，2026a；Kim 等，2025；Chin 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Broken access control (BAC) remains one of the most damaging classes of web-application vulnerabilities, yet its automated repair is still largely underexplored. This paper presented a systematic empirical study of the effectiveness of large language models (LLMs) in repairing BAC vulnerabilities in web applications. We constructed BAC-Bench , a benchmark of 46 real-world BAC vulnerabilities drawn from six widely used web applications spanning four programming languages. Each vulnerability is equipped with a documented description, a textual PoC description, the official patch, a sandboxed runtime environment, a PoC validation program, and a functional test program. We further propose a four-dimensional repair-strategy framework of Position, Coverage, Mechanism, and Content, which characterizes how BAC patches are constructed and explains why patches rejected by the dynamic tests fail. Our evaluation shows that base LLMs repair only 37.68% of the vulnerabilities on average in the single-turn setting, and that two minimal scaffolds, Apply-Feedback and Navigate-and-Locate , raise this average to 66.03%, with the highest-performing base LLM, Claude Opus 4.8, reaching 75.36%, only 3.63 percentage points below the 78.99% of Claude Code, the best-performing closed-source LLM agent (likewise built on Opus 4.8). Inferring the intended authorization policy, captured by the Content dimension, remains the dominant failure mode. Notably, some LLM-generated patches surpass the official fixes, and one even incidentally closed a zero-day vulnerability that had lain dormant for three years in Apache InLong. We responsibly disclosed this vulnerability to the Apache Software Foundation and the InLong maintainers, and it was assigned CVE-2026-63040. These results delineate the current capability boundary of LLM-based BAC repair and point to an important next step toward practical automated BAC repair, namely, inferring the precise authorization policy intended for each application’s specific business scenario. All artifacts are publicly available to facilitate future research.
paragraphs.zh: 损坏的访问控制（BAC）仍然是 Web 应用漏洞中危害最大的类别之一，但其自动化修复在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。 本文对大型语言模型（LLM）在修复 Web 应用中 BAC 漏洞方面的有效性进行了系统性的实证研究。 我们构建了 BAC-Bench，这是一个包含 46 个真实世界 BAC 漏洞的基准，这些漏洞来自四个编程语言编写的六个广泛使用的 Web 应用。 每个漏洞都配有书面描述、文本形式的 PoC 描述、官方补丁、沙箱化的运行环境、PoC 验证程序以及功能测试程序。 我们进一步提出了一个由位置、覆盖、机制和内容四个维度构成的修复策略框架，该框架刻画了 BAC 补丁的构建方式，并解释了为什么被动态测试拒绝的补丁会失败。 我们的评估表明，在单轮设置下，基础 LLM 平均只能修复 37.68% 的漏洞；而两个最小化的脚手架 Apply-Feedback 和 Navigate-and-Locate 将这一平均值提升到 66.03%，其中表现最佳的基础 LLM Claude Opus 4.8 达到 75.36%，仅比表现最佳的闭源 LLM 智能体（同样基于 Opus 4.8 构建）Claude Code 的 78.99% 低 3.63 个百分点。 推断预期的授权策略（由内容维度刻画）仍然是最主要的失败模式。 值得注意的是，一些 LLM 生成的补丁甚至超越了官方修复，其中一个还顺带修复了一个在 Apache InLong 中潜伏三年之久的零日漏洞。 我们以负责任的方式向 Apache 软件基金会和 InLong 的维护者披露了该漏洞，该漏洞被分配了 CVE-2026-63040 编号。 这些结果划定了基于 LLM 的 BAC 修复目前的能力边界，并指出了迈向实用化自动 BAC 修复的重要下一步，即推断每个应用在特定业务场景下所期望的精确授权策略。 所有工件均公开可用，以便促进未来研究。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 14 , Case C exemplifies the hunk-context mismatch pattern. The Kimi K2.7-Code patch for BookWyrm’s BW-2 vulnerability contains an extra blank line near the user_group assignment that is absent from the target source version. Although the discrepancy is visually minor, git apply performs strict hunk-context matching and therefore reports patch failed . Similar failures arise when a model adds or omits comments, decorators, blank lines, or nearby statements while reconstructing the target source context. Case D corresponding to Figure 15 presents a patch-path resolution failure. The Qwen3.7-Max patch for Apache InLong’s CVE-2023-31454 omits the conventional a/ and b/ prefixes from the file headers. Under the git apply -p1 path-stripping rule used in the experiment, the resulting path does not resolve to the target repository file, producing a No such file or directory error. The patch identifies the intended file in a human-readable form, but its path representation is incompatible with the application procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 如图14所示，案例C exemplifies… → 案例C体现了代码块上下文不匹配模式。 Kimi K2.7-Code 针对 BookWyrm 的 BW-2 漏洞所生成的补丁中，在 user_group 赋值附近包含一个目标源代码版本中不存在的多余空行。 尽管这一差异在视觉上很小，但 git apply 执行严格的代码块上下文匹配，因此报告 patch failed。 当模型在重建目标源代码上下文时添加或遗漏注释、装饰器、空行或邻近语句，也会出现类似的失败。 对应图15的案例D展示了一次补丁路径解析失败。 Qwen3.7-Max 针对 Apache InLong 的 CVE-2023-31454 所生成的补丁在文件头中省略了惯用的 a/ 和 b/ 前缀。 在实验所用的 git apply -p1 路径剥离规则下，所得到的路径无法解析到目标仓库文件，从而产生 No such file or directory 错误。 该补丁以人类可读的形式标识了目标文件，但其路径表示与应用（打补丁）流程不兼容。

sents.en: As illustrated in Figure 14 , Case C exemplifies the hunk-context mismatch pattern.
sents.zh: 如图14所示，案例C exemplifies… → 案例C体现了代码块上下文不匹配模式。

sents.en: The Kimi K2.7-Code patch for BookWyrm’s BW-2 vulnerability contains an extra blank line near the user_group assignment that is absent from the target source version.
sents.zh: Kimi K2.7-Code 针对 BookWyrm 的 BW-2 漏洞所生成的补丁中，在 user_group 赋值附近包含一个目标源代码版本中不存在的多余空行。

sents.en: Although the discrepancy is visually minor, git apply performs strict hunk-context matching and therefore reports patch failed .
sents.zh: 尽管这一差异在视觉上很小，但 git apply 执行严格的代码块上下文匹配，因此报告 patch failed。

sents.en: Similar failures arise when a model adds or omits comments, decorators, blank lines, or nearby statements while reconstructing the target source context.
sents.zh: 当模型在重建目标源代码上下文时添加或遗漏注释、装饰器、空行或邻近语句，也会出现类似的失败。

sents.en: Case D corresponding to Figure 15 presents a patch-path resolution failure.
sents.zh: 对应图15的案例D展示了一次补丁路径解析失败。

sents.en: The Qwen3.7-Max patch for Apache InLong’s CVE-2023-31454 omits the conventional a/ and b/ prefixes from the file headers.
sents.zh: Qwen3.7-Max 针对 Apache InLong 的 CVE-2023-31454 所生成的补丁在文件头中省略了惯用的 a/ 和 b/ 前缀。

sents.en: Under the git apply -p1 path-stripping rule used in the experiment, the resulting path does not resolve to the target repository file, producing a No such file or directory error.
sents.zh: 在实验所用的 git apply -p1 路径剥离规则下，所得到的路径无法解析到目标仓库文件，从而产生 No such file or directory 错误。

sents.en: The patch identifies the intended file in a human-readable form, but its path representation is incompatible with the application procedure.
sents.zh: 该补丁以人类可读的形式标识了目标文件，但其路径表示与应用（打补丁）流程不兼容。

paragraphs.en: In Case F, shown in Figure 16 , the DeepSeek-V4 Pro patch for OpenEMR’s CVE-2022-1177 exemplifies incomplete authorization-state reconstruction, specifically an incomplete ACL-policy update. The patch passes application-stage validation and adds an entry check for patients/pat_rep in custom_report.php . However, the complete repair also requires changing the ACL configuration state so that the existing patients/pat_rep permission is removed from the Front Office and Accounting ACL groups. The official patch implements this configuration change through installation or upgrade paths in files such as acl_upgrade.php , Installer.class.php , and AclExtended.php . Without these ACL configuration updates, the two groups continue to retain the relevant permission. Although the patch adds the appropriate authorization check, it does not update the underlying ACL state. Under the restricted source context, the LLM had no opportunity to fully explore the relevant parts of the OpenEMR repository and understand its complete ACL authorization mechanism. As a result, it produced a locally plausible but incomplete repair.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 16 所示的案例 F 中，DeepSeek-V4 Pro 针对 OpenEMR 的 CVE-2022-1177 所生成的补丁体现了授权状态重建不完整的问题，具体表现为 ACL 策略更新不完整。 该补丁通过了应用阶段验证，并在 custom_report.php 中为 patients/pat_rep 添加了入口检查。 然而，完整的修复还需要更改 ACL 配置状态，即从 Front Office 和 Accounting 这两个 ACL 组中移除现有的 patients/pat_rep 权限。 官方补丁通过 acl_upgrade.php、Installer.class.php 和 AclExtended.php 等文件中的安装或升级路径来实现这一配置更改。 缺少这些 ACL 配置更新，这两个组将继续保留相关权限。 尽管该补丁添加了适当的授权检查，但它并未更新底层的 ACL 状态。 在受限的源代码上下文下，该大语言模型没有机会充分探索 OpenEMR 仓库的相关部分并理解其完整的 ACL 授权机制。 因此，它生成了一个在局部看似合理但不完整的修复。

paragraphs.en: Figure 17 presents Case G, an instance of enforcement-point mislocalization. The DeepSeek-V4 Pro patch for Usememos’ CVE-2022-4684 adds MemoPatch.Validate(user, existing) in api/memo.go . However, the vulnerable PATCH /memo/:memoId handler in server/memo.go never invokes this method. The proposed ownership check therefore lies outside the effective execution path of the vulnerable request and cannot protect the operation.
paragraphs.zh: 图 17 展示了案例 G，这是执行点定位错误的一个实例。 针对 Usememos 的 CVE-2022-4684，DeepSeek-V4 Pro 补丁在 api/memo.go 中添加了 MemoPatch.Validate(user, existing)。 然而，server/memo.go 中存在漏洞的 PATCH /memo/:memoId 处理程序从未调用该方法。 因此，所提出的所有权检查位于存在漏洞的请求的有效执行路径之外，无法保护该操作。
